He’s a **West Point graduate** , a **combat pilot who flew Apache helicopters in Iraq** , a **business leader** , and a **father of three** raising his family with strong American values. **Now, he’s running for Governor because he believes Michigan deserves leadership grounded in service – not politics.** And the race just hit a critical turning point:
* A new poll shows John within **0.5%** of the Democrat front-runner.
* **National pundits now call Michigan a toss-up.****
* And the **DNC has labeled John their top target in the Midwest.****

That means everything is on the line. And the next 48 hours could shape the rest of this race. John’s campaign is fueled by patriots like you—not political insiders. That’s why he’s asking grassroots supporters to step up as **co-pilots** in this fight. He’s set an **emergency goal **to match the Democrats’ early spending and keep the momentum alive.

name: Mikie Sherrill (via Democrats.org)
subject: An update on my race:
body:
---
Derek, I’m Mikie Sherrill, and I am honored to be the official Democratic nominee for governor here in New Jersey. I wanted to take a minute to give you an update on my race and to explain why your support is so important today. The general election just got underway, and a new poll shows a statistical tie in the race for New Jersey governor. But I’ve spent my whole career running toward tough fights — as a Navy helicopter pilot, a federal prosecutor, and a Congresswoman fighting for New Jerseyans. I promise you, I am going to work every single day to win this one — because the stakes for our families, our state, and our democracy are way too high for anything less. The fact is, New Jersey is now a battleground state. And Trump is already campaigning for my opponent, Jack Ciattarelli, a career politician who has promised to pass an abortion ban, defund public schools, and bring DOGE to New Jersey. **So, truthfully, we won’t win this race and those down the ticket unless we have a strong grassroots team behind us right from the start.** That’s why I’m asking for your help today. [Will you split a $10 contribution to the New Jersey Democratic State Committee and the DNC today? ### **Cliff 's Note: Trump Tweets Comparison of Hiroshima to Bombing Iran. Did he Inject That Bleach After all?**
**Lose Tweets Sink Fleets**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e3d5943c-4020-4edd-be6d-1a768ffbc6f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I'm gonna be straight with you, our much appreciated and brilliant readers. I've probably written over a hundred columns on Trump alone. And I may honestly be running out of creative ways to convey what a galactic fuck-up this snarling jester is on a global scale.
This whiny little bitch of a man bombs Iran, then tweets--because why would you save these announcements for a venue where you're not on the golden crapper?--that a ceasefire is in place... _while_ _the bombs are still falling_. That's not just propaganda, it's the high-pitched newspeak of the clinically insane.
Then he "Truths" that he destroyed his intended targets, which his own intelligence chief responds to with, "nuh, uh," along with numerous press sources, leaks from his administration, military analysts and more. So, he tweets again:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3522a106-8777-4323-ac7a-cbabb04bf6e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
With delusion, cowardice and isolation-from-intellect so severe that Trump thinks just *saying it* on "Truth Social" makes it truth. This is what we accomplished when we elected a repellent narcissist with the attention span of a fruit fly. When we gave this planet of mendacity, this non-stop JumboTron of horse shit, bombers instead of a court date.
Trump isn't running a government--he's running a social media _LARP_ , and real people are dying for it. To paraphrase _Field of Dreams_ , Trump thinks if (with his stubby little fingers) he types it, it will come. So "peace" becomes real because he tweeted it (though it hasn't seemed to work for his hair).
In the real world, however, our fighter jets are still in the air, targets are still being hit, and American credibility is in free fall. There is no ceasefire, just like there is no closet to Narnia, no Wolverine fighting with the X-Men and no River Styx....
> Though, Charon, if you're listening, I hope you're able to find Trump's 30,000 scams just since he got back to the White House. Though I probably don't think you'll be rewarded by our corporate press, who has cheap Biden-dementia books to hawk.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ab0c1ba8-dff5-454f-9dfc-4e0cf4b1b3ea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This isn't diplomacy--it's a live-action ego trip with airstrikes providing the entertainment. And every time the dumb MFer hits "post," another ally loses faith, another enemy is emboldened, and the rest of us hold our breath hoping the next missile doesn't drag us into World War III. [Thankfully, even some of his former supporters are even beginning to get](https://substack.com/redirect/3f7791a1-0cf3-4d4a-a3c9-8b83a3e59f13?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that this is the undeniable truth--not Truth Social.

Yet, the bootlickers cheer. Pete Hegseth, JD Vance, this entire speechless-in-Dear-Leader's presence, cabal of spineless MAGA lapdogs who confuse performative toughness with leadership. They sit on TV and X acting like Trump's latest tantrum is some 4D chess move, when it's just a 78-year-old crazy-pants rage-posting between bites of overcooked steak.
These hammerheads don't care who dies, so long as they get a Fox News hit, a pat on the head from the Orange Pharaoh and a shot at leading the caucus of the damned in the future.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b9c993eb-5f64-4451-8ffe-94cdd6c982c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Look, we're not in a Woody Allen film. Foreign policy by tweet isn't just dumb-as-a-door-hinge behavior--it's _dangerous_. The world isn't your therapy, Donnie. You don't get to bomb a country, lie about a ceasefire and then go back to cheating at golfing like nothing happened.
Every reckless word, each impulsive post, all the cringe communication, carries the weight of real human consequences, even if **you** don't care, Don. This isn't reality TV. It's reality. And the man is playing with American lives while Mike Johnson, Ron Johnson--really all the Republican Johnsons--do nothing be egg him on and line up his ass for kissing.
It's not just Iran. It's our standing in the world. Our economy. Our troops. And Trump, as always, couldn't care less. Because the bombs aren't dropping _on him_. Or his money. He's safe behind the Secret Service, tweeting from the Saddam Hussein penthouse in Florida or the white house in Washington he usurped form its real owners.
Also, authoritarians never stop at one war. Especially those [who suffer from vampire-like bloodlust](https://substack.com/redirect/c6d8339e-a3dd-4bd1-894c-cc8660cccbac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). They feed on conflict, chaos, and fear--because it's the only way they know how to feel powerful. Trump bombed Iran because he wanted to punish someone, _anyone_ , to feel big again. He tweeted about a ceasefire to soothe his own ego, not make the world feel safe.
And his enablers? They'd sell out their mother for a Cabinet post and a selfie at Mar-a-Lago.
Don't let them gaslight you. Don't let them act like diplomatic proposal or threat via tweet is normal. It's madness via social media platforms built for cult worship and Q-anon. The only ceasefire that's real is the one where this dingus finally gets _fired_ --from public life, from relevance, from our democracy--for good.
In the meantime, **FFS, will you cock-up group of cowards who surround him like the stink of of 1000 unwashed mules take away his damn phone already!!**

body:
I want you to know where I stand:
Peter — I’ve always believed that if any political candidate is going to ask you for your hard-earned money, they have an obligation to share with you exactly where they stand on key issues.
So if you have a moment, I’d like to share with you where I stand on three key issues in this race, and how my position compares with my opponent’s. And if after reading this, your views align with mine, I hope you will **[split $10 or whatever amount works for you between my campaign and Heartland Patriots to help me win what could be a nail-biter of an election.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/90121?refcode=em20250625-9048&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9048%2E614464%2EW68XSP)**
**Abortion rights**
**Where I stand:** The decision of if and when to start a family is one that every woman deserves to make for herself — period. As governor, I will work to permanently protect reproductive freedom in our state by enshrining the right to an abortion in New Jersey's state constitution, as well as stockpile mifepristone and strengthen protections for providers.
**Where my opponent stands:** He supports an abortion ban and wants to defund Planned Parenthood in New Jersey.
**Affordability**
**Where I stand:** My top priority is making every aspect of daily life more affordable for New Jerseyans — and I’ve put forward detailed plans on how to lower the cost of housing, health care, child care, energy, groceries, and the taxes that working families pay.
**Where my opponent stands:** Proudly alongside Trump as national Republicans try to cut Medicaid, endanger Medicare, take away food assistance, and give billionaires a massive tax break. In fact, he’s not only urging Republican Members of Congress to vote for Trump’s agenda — _he’s promising to implement it at the state level in New Jersey, too._
**The Rule of Law**
**Where I stand:** The first time I took an oath to defend the Constitution, I was a teenager entering the Naval Academy. Ever since then, that oath has been the north star for everything I do. I’ve never been afraid to run toward a tough fight, and as governor, I will defend your rights and your freedoms from anyone who tries to take them away.
**Where my opponent stands:** He got Trump’s endorsement in this race after shamelessly begging for it. He quite literally hitched a ride on a helicopter to rush to Trump’s golf club in Bedminster to ask for the endorsement. If he so willingly bent the knee before the election, why would we expect anything different after taking office?
**[Peter, if you prefer my vision for New Jersey over my opponent’s, then I am humbly asking you to help me get my message out to voters all across the state by splitting $10 or more between my campaign and Heartland Patriots today.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/90121?refcode=em20250625-9048&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=9048%2E614464%2EW68XSP)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/90122?refcode=em20250625-9048&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=3&akid=9048%2E614464%2EW68XSP) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/90122?refcode=em20250625-9048&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=4&akid=9048%2E614464%2EW68XSP) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/90122?refcode=em20250625-9048&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=5&akid=9048%2E614464%2EW68XSP) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/90122?refcode=em20250625-9048&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=6&akid=9048%2E614464%2EW68XSP) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/90122?refcode=em20250625-9048&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=7&akid=9048%2E614464%2EW68XSP) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/90122?refcode=em20250625-9048&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=8&akid=9048%2E614464%2EW68XSP) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/90121?refcode=em20250625-9048&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=9&akid=9048%2E614464%2EW68XSP)

| Scott Brown just announced his campaign in New Hampshire.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=8719%2E5257348%2ENMxR0Q)
It’s official, Derek:
**Scott Brown just announced he’s running to flip New Hampshire’s Senate seat red.**
If that name sounds familiar, it’s because he’s run for Senate — and lost — before. In Massachusetts. Then he ran here, hoping Granite Staters wouldn’t notice. But we did.
Now he’s back, with support from the national Republican machine, trying to buy his way into the Senate again. It’s up to our grassroots team to stop him.
[**Derek, split a $10 contribution now between my campaign and Adam Schiff and join the fight to beat Scott Brown.**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=abs-em-pappas25.90nCIT&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_RES_AC90_20250625_PM2_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=4&akid=8719%2E5257348%2ENMxR0Q)
**This is a serious threat.** The GOP sees New Hampshire as one of their best chances to expand their Senate majority — and they’re counting on Scott Brown to help them do it.
_But this seat doesn’t belong to Scott Brown. It belongs to the people of New Hampshire._
I was born and raised here. I’ve run a family business, represented our communities in Concord and in Congress, and delivered for the people who call this state home — from lowering prescription drug costs to defending reproductive freedom and our democracy.
Scott Brown’s record is clear:
❌ He supports Trump’s MAGA agenda.
❌ He voted to defund Planned Parenthood.
❌ He opposed marriage equality and the _Affordable Care Act_.
That’s not who we are. And that’s not who should represent us.
This race is now one of the most competitive in the country — and the GOP is ready to pour millions into this race to try to win it and expand the Republican Senate majority.
**But we’ve beaten Scott Brown before. And with your help, we’ll do it again.**
[**If you’re with us, split a $10 donation right now between my campaign and Adam Schiff to help us fight back and keep this seat in the hands of someone who actually knows and serves New Hampshire.**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=abs-em-pappas25.90nCIT&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_RES_AC90_20250625_PM2_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=5&akid=8719%2E5257348%2ENMxR0Q)

| | Hi Peter – it’s U.S. Congressman Mark Takano.

This Pride Month, I wanted to tell you a little about my story and my first race for Congress. **

**When I ran for Congress in the 1990s, I was publicly outed as gay by bigoted Republicans and made the target of homophobic attack ads.

I would go on to lose that race by more than 18% – **but I didn’t stop fighting.

**In 2012, I ran again and won by 19%, becoming the first openly gay person of color to serve in Congress. Something I’m still deeply proud of to this day.

Now, a little over three decades since my first campaign, I’m proud and honored to be Chair of the Equality Caucus, serving alongside a historic number of 13 openly LGBTQ members of Congress.

_Together, we are fighting every day in Congress to protect LGBTQ+ Americans and our rights. _

I would go on to lose that race by more than 18% – but I didn’t stop fighting. In 2012, I ran again and won by 19%, becoming the first openly gay person of color to serve in Congress. Something I’m still deeply proud of to this day. Now, a little over three decades since my first campaign, I’m proud and honored to be Chair of the Equality Caucus, serving alongside a historic number of 13 openly LGBTQ members of Congress. Together, we are fighting every day in Congress to protect LGBTQ+ Americans and our rights. | | = If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your contribution will go through immediately: = = = = = = While I’m proud to celebrate how far we’ve come since my first run for Congress, the fight is still ongoing. And LGBTQ+ rights are increasingly under attack by Republicans. That is why we fight every Congress to pass the Equality Act, which would end all LGBTQ discrimination across our nation – a law that 75 percent of Americans support, including a majority of Republicans and Independents. Despite that truth, bigoted Republicans continue to push an anti-LGBTQ, far-right agenda: from anti-trans discrimination to begging the Supreme Court to overturn same-sex marriage to cutting life-saving Medicaid services for HIV that impact the most vulnerable in our community. Just in 2025 alone, over 500 anti-LGBTQ+ bills have been introduced, and that’s not including the ongoing attacks from the Trump administration. But Peter, as Chair of the Equality Caucus, I’m leading the charge in Congress to protect LGBTQ+ rights and fight back against these disgraceful and bigoted Republican attacks. = If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your contribution will go through immediately: = = = = = = Thank you, and happy Pride Month. As the Chair of the California Democratic Congressional Delegation, she has been on the front lines of expanding and protecting the Democratic Majority. subject: Where we go next

body:
https://kellyforcongress.org [https://kellyforcongress.org]
Hi Peter,
The last 11 days have been filled with heartbreak as our state grieves this horrific tragedy. I am so grateful for this community – so many of you showed up to the Capitol last Wednesday for the vigil in honor of Melissa and Mark, and it was beautiful to see so many people there who cared for and loved the Hortman family. While this is a personal loss for many of us, this grief is collective across Minnesota and our entire country. But to grieve so deeply means we also love very deeply, and I pray that the Hortman family feels the collective love from all of us.
Photo of the memorial for Melissa and Mark Hortman at the Minnesota State Capitol taken at twilight during the candlelight vigil. [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP59/1/109390/images/places/hortman-memorial.png]
So many conversations that I’m having right now revolve around the question “where do we go from here?” While I don’t know that anyone has just the right answer, continuing to work for the causes that Melissa fought so hard for is the best way I can honor her legacy.
Let me be clear: this horrific violence was also an attack on the American people. It was an attack on democracy itself. We cannot let this tragedy keep us from engaging or deter good people from running for office. Now more than ever, we need everyone to be involved in our communities and our democracy.
So let’s resolve to continue working for the common good together. Let’s continue to engage, take care of each other and lead with kindness and compassion.
Please don’t hesitate to reach out to me and my team if you need anything at all. Thank you so much for your continued support, partnership, and kindness.
With gratitude and resolve,
Kelly Morrison

## Democrats Enter Races for Governor, U.S. Senate
An East Texas rancher and a retired astronaut are running for governor and U.S. Senate as Democrats. [Bobby Cole](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2ypCAUhJ8GMyz-BiEg2MTsbrqhdUYODrUoU3BK77z9lvcVNuvo6-7vz9fyBbnkY_sNOwb6TnU58OoFibAtJZ_Y_uZjg9awE0bCY637DosS6sGF5couEXL5LGaI4SmilwMGOT2E1w_rp-EVvJkcSptcVJN7Ku1XGTVG52SKaCc_5HDDhFVWSiG1GZ3RTyOE9cJYlxCYERgz1TbSCwm_oafyqSe2ca37UMKL6N2Z_sXUzNR8Xde4Prv0I51MzdAorwWZmu9fTM3vWjLl9Y4InfgPkCdoOzZ-fvKx8VQbpxfy7S45auu8IxBT80NI7jyAExNwE-XKTUrInUnAEay2zuuoUhpaiO8rl5K7nZgR2w65_Kyl_3N8BvUvAAD__9WWj4A), a retired firefighter who runs a ranch in Quitman, is a first-time candidate who describes himself as a “traditional Democrat” in the mold of LBJ and FDR. Among his priorities are funding public schools, improving the power grid, growing the economy, and cutting property taxes. In a [social media post](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGuozAQheGnMR1oPDYGChfb0GXbLZExA1hrbGRGIXn7q-QVbn2k70j_v8f0cCGGtP11B1l-rXlKdF-RmKlMMTyp_A9pc6XQxbQwJZ-Pw00I2NZgajTT4kJ8T7pa7AzLICuysmthUK0Zumq3vptdS944tXbdrJ1Zfd-DMZ1CNYOWVbAfDAwaKUEq3fRazRrADKBNv5ITGmgJnEvDOzG93LXGd35SaXw-qmh35vMS6o_AUeB433fj95LTZxU4njkGDv4SOLrCwUcSOH6VevsgKZeaInkOOdUIaGoENSBK2Zz7WRW7nHeIMVymExq2w4X4_eXf1Xpa_AkAAP__Ftp-KQ), Cole accused Abbott of "tearing up everything we’ve built" and "kissing up to bullies and billionaires.” Retired astronaut [Terry Virts](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDFvpDAQRn-N6QbZgzFL4WIbdE2uTYkcPIATY6_sYcn--1Ouu_q6T_qkp6f3_ja_uRBD2n67gyx_r3lOdNVIzFTmGJ5UvkLaXClUmTxTWvJxuBkl9iANoJm9C_E168bbD-lH1ZBVQy_Hrjfj0OxWD5JQe-3U2iFKP4zoTY-9lCveFKkm2B-YNGiUkqrT7U13H1pKM0ptbis5oSX5wLm0vBPTt6trfOUnlXbJRxPtzvyoorsLnARO13W1R00_n8CJEpxV4LRRouLiP6sQh0Ie9nxWzglc5ZKTOxk-z-NRISTOUNxCwBnYfRHkBCdUqJTgM-8JllzSKwmcXIH7Xf3ah_fSFOsfV4gxVDMILbfDhfjXlP-v79PinwAAAP__QaaQmQ), also a first-time candidate, announced he is running for Sen. John Cornyn’s seat on Monday, calling the incumbent “just another D.C. insider who has lost touch with Texas.” Virts was the commander of the International Space Station.
## 'Liver King' Arrested in Austin
A social media influencer known as the “Liver King” was arrested in Austin Tuesday night after making a [series of threats](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkMGOpCAURb9GdxhACnXBYjbuarazNA95KDMIFXhTVvXXd-ykv6C39yY395w_9-UOIYa0_YYDDb18XhKeNSIRliWGJ5Z_IW1QClZCR5jWfBywSC5vjGsm9eIgxPeiWmcsd5No0Yjhxqf-pqeh3Q0K6a0btdVODL2zVtphEA5Bj-tonWiDuca4lloILnrVjaq3inM9caVHj9Aoji5QLh3tSPiC6uM7P7F0az7aaHaiR236X42cGzmf59n5_Loorr6R8__ayLnAyQ4EYggU0sZ8oIS1skpQ2DceA09YmA0fV8LWHWLEtCH7m5GVvEFqi3GPM8QYqh4axbcDQvz6QT-z9zTyMwAA__9I7YeZ) against podcaster Joe Rogan, who has lived in the Texas capital since 2020. The YouTuber, whose real name is Brian Johnson, posted a video on Monday in which he challenged Rogan to an “honorable” fight while [wearing a wolf pelt](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD1uxCAQhU-DO1YYY2wXFGncbdqUFobBJsGwgtkf3z5ipZwg3ZNm9M187-u6XLUPPm6f-gCFL5eWCM8SABHyEvwD8o-Pm84ZCoJFiCYdh1444z1lknK5WO3DuYjGqpXZqW1AtUPPpq6X09DsCvg49uM6DU4z008C3KB7wx2Y0QwrN41XFcYkl23L2k5cRtGtgjE5MSFHB5oIBtZjyhfcAeGliwtnekC-mHQ0Qe2It0K6D8Jnwud43lLBOiJ8rmTCZyZrruleaPUjfH670SpH_-yoj_TNp1afhWqHkKnRofZD0x3pdwKa06Zj3bzH3ccNLK33KrHJyt6ePgRf5EAE2w7tw_tH_F-zD8V_AwAA__8vpo5n) and holding an exotic firearm in each hand. “ _Man to man, I’m picking a fight with you. I have no training in jiu-jitsu, you’re a black belt, you should dismantle me_ ,” [he said](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFvwyAQBeBfgzdbB8Y4DAxdvKVrR4uYc3IqhghfQ_LvK0fqL-j-9J6-93Wez54ipeun39Dxc81zwrpHZMYyR3pg-aZ09aXgzhgY05K3zc8K1NCCaZWZg6f4mnUT3AWClQ06OQ5g-8HYsbm5Naj1oqUce9WfwMtxMGAHO-CirZY-NOSOMjDKSAmy191J9xcNYCxoc1rRCw0YiHPp-IaMT7-v8ZUfWLolb010N-b7LvoPoSahplprdxCSZ8op5XqkhJqWQhsKNb1N7YFq_1St_9mZklBTU1y4V4qRdjMKDdfNU3zP8P_OeTj1GwAA__8mc3ms). “ _Your rules, I’ll come to you, whenever you’re ready_.” Johnson, 47, has claimed his muscular physique is from [eating raw meat](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1urDAQBeCnMZ2R_5jFhYsrXdHtba6ilMiLB3Bi8Mqe7M_bR6yUJ0g9o6PznffzePYxxX355zd09JjzuOO9JiTCMqZ4w_IZ98WXgpUwEO5T3jY_KqE6LoArGIOP6TmaJriLCFY26OSpE1Z3YE_N6oTsO4N2VkL289RZO8M0YbACLCgM0ER3hAlQIKWQ2rS90RcjBFhhoJ_RMyMwRMqlpRUJH77O6ZlvWNopb01yK9G1Mv2HqYGpwV-mQ9Au-TgzNbz9Z2p4SfhB4T8W7r8qxZ37mbBwWgt6wv34-MjIS178ztRQKZcn00MMTP-VSksLGrqmuHC9x5RihRMzYtl8TK869LsRb059BwAA__-93oZJ) and doing intense workouts, but he was forced to admit in 2022 that he spends $11,000 a month on steroids. He is detained in the Travis County Jail on a charge of making a terroristic threat.

_Destination X_ , NBC’s new reality show that drops contestants in an unknown location and challenges them to figure out where they are, features [two women from Austin](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uozAUhJ_GdI6McQwULrahu9tuiQ72CTm6_onss4G8_Yr7CtvOjD7NzJ-v9QsoUt5_Q0LH56OsGY8WkRnrGumN9ZvyDrViYwyM2ZeUYNVK36WyUts1AMXParrgNhXmvkPXj3c1D3c7j93T-Qmtwc17ADST7WHowz2MYfZhnOZgOnIXTFlt-171g7lNZtiMUnZWxk4PBGEUBuJSb_xExhPaI37KG-vNl9RF92R-NTH8EnoRejmO4_Z9Qr5MoRfMjJWBcsLM8tom9JIQWcLfxpTlBg2D9CUzNobMTZbHlZN7LBtyLcyUd1kRIvFH-pJeyMRUsmzPcsiAFwZ-hFPopasuvA6KkZodhVF7Aoo_Tfn__n07_S8AAP__-aKVQA)—Mackenzie “Mack” Fitzgerald and Allyson “Ally” Bross. **Brookly in the 1970 's**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/645d65ba-a75f-4922-bb06-289d0e91438c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Above is a photo of what rent control did to Brooklyn. These are buildings that were abandoned because of frozen rents and escalating costs. The landlords walked away and the buildings were not maintained and became uninhabitable.
Thanks for reading The Goldstein Substack! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.
[Pledge your support](https://substack..L3GvSWX2hssKBERRs4z_QNMGUzAbNpDV8O9w2pA4nSU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=166886449)
In the 1970's I used to drive through this neighborhood both in medical school and during my residency. This photo is typical of what I saw. Whole neighborhoods looked like this.
This is what socialism does. All of the woke liberals need to wake up and understand that there are no such thing as freebees.
Public housing run by NYC is in disrepair and often not kept up to building codes.
Now that rent control is gone buildings in this neighborhood have either been rebuilt or replaced.
We in Connecticut are drifting toward rent regulation and housing regulation. Fortunately the governor vetoed the absurd HB5002 bill that would have led to the destruction of the right of towns through their elected officials to control their own destiny. We also have the fair housing bill that will ultimately lead to rent regulation and control. The best way to preserve rental housing is to make it profitable for landlords to maintain and operate their buildings.
The second and most important solution is for towns to make a concerted effort to reduce the regulatory burdens and thereby lower the cost to build affordable housing.
Companies need affordable housing for their workers to live in. Otherwise they cannot operate.
There is a societal interest in facilitating the free market to build, preferably owned affordable housing.
It was done on a large scale throughout the country in the post WWII era and can be done today.
College and Universities who receive federal funding and other subsidies need to regain the academic freedom that has been hijacked by woke left wing professors. There should be free and open debate regarding the differences between free market capitalism and government regulated socialism.
But the most important question that needs to be answered is why is there a massive immigration to the United States from people freeing socialist and communist societies if life under those systems are that wonderful. Talk to anyone who has fled these countries and they are in shock that people are voting to transform the US to a society that they fled from.
In 2025 we have municipal elections which will decide who will lead our towns. Every voter who cares about the future of their town, this state and our country must wake up and support candidates who believe in our free market democracy.
If not and socialism takes over this is what housing will look like. Or in the alternative your next door neighbors house could be demolished and replaced with a skyscraper.
Elections count and our future will be decided in the 2025 local elections and the 2026 statewide and federal elections.

name: Kamala Harris
subject: You deserve an explanation.
body:
Right now, you've got a whole lot of Republicans who are on the fence about what Trump is doing with regards to tax cuts for the rich

Peter --
In just a moment, I am going to ask you to make a contribution directly to the Democratic National Committee. Please give me a chance to explain why this request -- especially today -- is so important for everyone who cares about the future of this country.
Here's the truth:
In just a few days, the DNC closes the books on a very important FEC fundraising deadline. When it ends, they are legally required to report what they've raised and how many donations they've received will eventually be public as well.
And here's why that matters:
Right now, you've got a few Republicans who are on the fence about what Trump is doing with regards to tax cuts for the rich, cutting services for the poor, and the tariffs that are wreaking havoc on our economy. And those issues are just the start.
And when these FEC reports are filed, Republican Party leaders will be looking at what the DNC raises and consider making some critical decisions about whether or not they'll be held accountable for supporting Trump and his agenda.
If the DNC can file a big report -- especially one with lots of donations - they'll see Americans are fired up and ready to fight with the Democrats. Republicans will have to consider the spending the party can do to defeat them.
So yes, the money is important. It will be used to organize and stop Trump's agenda while electing Democrats everywhere. But the report the DNC files is critical as well. That is why I am asking, humbly:

# China’s Foothold in Nashua NH and Xi’s Soft Power Invasion
For two months’ I have been raising questions about Nongfu Springs, the largest beverage company in China, which is owned by the richest man in China, Zhong Shanshan, whom paid $67 million for a piece of commercial real estate in Nashua appraised at only $15 million. See my interview with News Nation. [Is China eyeing New Hampshire’s water as part of a ‘soft power invasion’?](https://lilytangwilliams.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8317033781a524f5f640e7e3e&id=e16d52a975&e=c338950e03)

Situated on the 23 acre property at 80 Northwest Blvd. in Nashua is an empty building that spans 337,000 square feet. It is close to the Nashua Airport, which has a runway long enough to support military aircraft, and close to a major Federal Aviation Administration control center. L3Harris, a very important defense contractor, is literally across street, and BAE, another defense contractor, is only a few miles away. New Boston Space Force Station is just 35 minutes by car.

Most concerning though, the Nashua property is within 100 miles of Cape Cod Joint Base in Massachusetts, one of the most critical military infrastructures listed by the Committee for Foreign Investment in the U.S. (CFIUS) which is under the U.S. Treasury Department. Thus, local leaders and residents must take the lead and at the least question this deal, which includes selling a lot of water to Nongfu Springs when only a short while ago residents were being asked to conserve. Strange indeed.

The federal government must do their due diligence as required by CFIUS rules. What exactly is going on with Nongfu’s presence here in New Hampshire? Bottled water from Nashua? Really? Why not the North Country, a much more pristine area with clean mountain water?

Representative Goodlander, who sits on US House Armed Forces Committee, has not said anything on this deal, even though Nashua is ostensibly the city where she resides. Maybe she know what is going on?

This video clip has 9.9 million views on YouTube, even Joe Rogan

---
| | | Once again, Trump is refusing to take responsibility, and blaming others instead. And he's lashing out at the media because they had the audacity to question his obvious lies: _" President Donald Trump on Wednesday called reporters "scum" for not parroting his rosy assessment of the air strikes he ordered against Iran last week...Appearing at a NATO meeting at The Hague in the Netherlands, Trump was asked by NBC reporter Kelly O'Donnell to address a recently leaked assessment from the Pentagon's Defense Intelligence Agency that indicates the strikes did not achieve Trump's goal._ _" Real scum, real scum come out and write reports that are as negative as they could possibly be. It should be the opposite, you should make [the pilots] heroes and heroines," Trump said. body:

| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z33mnjleu2aiej0m5po6dupvpvc11qsftrsqt84g_rp22sh2s8i6epb0cjim9o32c3h2bs)

| | Dear Fellow Conservative,

Do you know the truth about the Declaration of Independence?

This revolutionary document laid down the foundation of American political thought, far before our Founding Fathers won the Revolutionary War and wrote the Constitution.
---
|
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zsrj45gbedha6l1taabpvteb75r22ekal65nr9p8_rp22sh2s8i6epb0cjim9o32c3h2bs)
---
| | In an era where the radical Left has attacked our individual liberty and America’s founding ideals, all Americans should have a robust understanding of this document, and the principles found within.

**That’s why our policy experts at The Heritage Foundation created[ _The Guide to the Declaration of Independence eBook_](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zbdbpvs6029n8k3cjmt67a37m82959ujmomv4hsg_rp22sh2s8i6epb0cjim9o32c3h2bs).**

This FREE eBook breaks down this important founding document’s history, including:
* Why our Founders decided to declare independence.
* The writing process for the Declaration.
* The philosophical tradition that informed our Founding Fathers’ thinking.
* How the Declaration affected American politics.
* And much more!

This eBook is an essential tool for all American patriots who want to learn more about our nation’s founding principles.

**You can get your FREE digital copy using the secure link below.**

**[https://secured.heritage.org/guide-to-the-declaration-ebook/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z7vb09s0d5ue2k55m4378oqv1rjbp5o5orh372ko_rp22sh2s8i6epb0cjim9o32c3h2bs)**

I hope you find it both informative and edifying.

Sincerely,

Kevin D. Roberts, Ph.D.
President, The Heritage Foundation

Sen. Markwayne Mullin **[blasted CNN's Kaitlan Collins](https://substack.com/redirect/0fd504ee-d4b6-4a1a-8eea-c88cfa3c24ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for challenging the success of President Donald Trump's strikes on Iran in a heated live interview.
"Why is this so hard for you to celebrate?!!"
[Click To Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/0fd504ee-d4b6-4a1a-8eea-c88cfa3c24ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/0fd504ee-d4b6-4a1a-8eea-c88cfa3c24ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Collins started by asking Mullin if he has personally seen any intelligence to confirm that Iran's nuclear program was obliterated.
**["I'll tell you that the reports that we receive, this was a complete success!"](https://substack.com/redirect/0fd504ee-d4b6-4a1a-8eea-c88cfa3c24ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Mullin answered. "I don't understand why this is such a hard thing for CNN to celebrate! This should be something that we are celebrating, not something we're trying to bring division on!"
"No one is trying to bring any division, and it has nothing to do with celebrating or not celebrating it sir, it's a question of what the intelligence shows," Collins responded. "So my question, sir, is have you seen intelligence that shows the nuclear program has been obliterated?"
Mullin again confirmed that reports given to the Senate show the program was completely destroyed. "That doesn't mean they can't start their program again because you can't eliminate knowledge, but they can't use these facilities anymore, that's a fact!"

# Tom Homan warns NYC socialist mayoral primary winner: "He's not gonna stop us!"
President Donald Trump's border czar Tom Homan **[warned Democratic socialist Zohran Mamdani](https://substack.com/redirect/da0dc870-aa98-47e8-b1af-cd7f3fa67c23?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on Wednesday that he is no match for ICE after the newly victorious mayoral primary winner promised to "kick the fascist ICE out of New York City" and strengthen the city's sanctuary protections.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/19a68999-697b-4461-b467-d1b1d73e6c15?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Border czar Tom Homan directly challenged Mamdani's promise to "kick the fascist ICE out of New York City"** \- Homan told Fox Business that "federal law trumps him every day" and warned the newly victorious Democratic primary winner that ICE operations would continue regardless of local opposition, saying "Good luck with that" and "it's game on."
* **Homan vowed to increase ICE enforcement in New York specifically because it's a sanctuary city** \- He said Trump's administration would "double down and triple down" on sanctuary cities like New York because they release "public safety threats and national security threats back to the street," promising to send more agents and increase worksite enforcement "tenfold."
* **The conflict stems from Mamdani's campaign promise to "Trump-proof" NYC and strengthen sanctuary protections** \- The 33-year-old Queens assemblyman has vowed to get ICE out of all city facilities, end cooperation with federal immigration enforcement, and protect immigrant New Yorkers' personal data as part of his fight against what he calls Trump's attempts to "gouge the working class."
* **Homan praised current Mayor Eric Adams while criticizing Mamdani's approach** \- The border czar said Adams "wants to do the right thing" and be a "law-and-order mayor" who helps ICE find missing trafficked children, contrasting this with Mamdani's confrontational stance, which included shouting at Homan in the state capitol and being removed by state troopers in March.

* **A Republican state assemblyman[called out AOC for claiming to be a "Bronx girl"](https://substack.com/redirect/6cb7f343-ed25-4fb2-bfcc-cab916377d45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by posting her high school yearbook photo** \- Matt Slater, who attended Yorktown High School with Ocasio-Cortez, shared her freshman yearbook picture and tweeted "If you're a BX girl then why are you in my Yorktown yearbook?" after she used her Bronx identity in a social media spat with Trump.
* **The controversy arose from AOC's response to Trump's personal attacks during their Iran policy dispute** \- After Trump called her "stupid" and "one of the 'dumbest' people in Congress" following her calls for his impeachment over Iran strikes, Ocasio-Cortez fired back saying "I'm a Bronx girl" and that "we can eat Queens boys for breakfast," referring to Trump's Queens upbringing.
* **Slater accused AOC of creating a "false narrative" about her roots for political gain** \- The assemblyman argued that AOC's constant references to the Bronx despite growing up in suburban Yorktown Heights "disrespects this town" and represents the kind of "manufactured, fake" leadership people are tired of, noting she lived in the Bronx only until age 5 before moving to Westchester County for better schools.

President Donald Trump's border czar Tom Homan on Wednesday that he is no match for ICE after the newly victorious mayoral primary winner promised to "kick the fascist ICE out of New York City" and strengthen the city's sanctuary protections. Border czar Tom Homan directly challenged Mamdani's promise to "kick the fascist ICE out of New York City" \- Homan told Fox Business that "federal law trumps him every day" and warned the newly victorious Democratic primary winner that ICE operations would continue regardless of local opposition, saying "Good luck with that" and "it's game on." Homan vowed to increase ICE enforcement in New York specifically because it's a sanctuary city \- He said Trump's administration would "double down and triple down" on sanctuary cities like New York because they release "public safety threats and national security threats back to the street," promising to send more agents and increase worksite enforcement "tenfold." The conflict stems from Mamdani's campaign promise to "Trump-proof" NYC and strengthen sanctuary protections \- The 33-year-old Queens assemblyman has vowed to get ICE out of all city facilities, end cooperation with federal immigration enforcement, and protect immigrant New Yorkers' personal data as part of his fight against what he calls Trump's attempts to "gouge the working class." Homan praised current Mayor Eric Adams while criticizing Mamdani's approach \- The border czar said Adams "wants to do the right thing" and be a "law-and-order mayor" who helps ICE find missing trafficked children, contrasting this with Mamdani's confrontational stance, which included shouting at Homan in the state capitol and being removed by state troopers in March. Republican EXPOSES fake "Bronx girl" AOC lived in affluent suburb | | ---|---|--- A Republican state assemblyman by posting her high school yearbook photo \- Matt Slater, who attended Yorktown High School with Ocasio-Cortez, shared her freshman yearbook picture and tweeted "If you're a BX girl then why are you in my Yorktown yearbook?" after she used her Bronx identity in a social media spat with Trump. The controversy arose from AOC's response to Trump's personal attacks during their Iran policy dispute \- After Trump called her "stupid" and "one of the 'dumbest' people in Congress" following her calls for his impeachment over Iran strikes, Ocasio-Cortez fired back saying "I'm a Bronx girl" and that "we can eat Queens boys for breakfast," referring to Trump's Queens upbringing. Slater accused AOC of creating a "false narrative" about her roots for political gain \- The assemblyman argued that AOC's constant references to the Bronx despite growing up in suburban Yorktown Heights "disrespects this town" and represents the kind of "manufactured, fake" leadership people are tired of, noting she lived in the Bronx only until age 5 before moving to Westchester County for better schools. | | POLL Would you ever visit NYC if they actually elect a socialist mayor? | ? ? ? ? Got some good news that's been a long time coming.
We - along with AGs from all 50 states and 6 U.S. territories - have now reached the _final settlement_ with Purdue Pharma and the Sackler family for their role in starting the opioid epidemic.
This goes back to the 1990s. Purdue Pharma - owned by the Sackler family - lied to a bunch of doctors by saying they had invented a new opioid pill that wasn't addictive.
The pill was OxyContin, it was _highly_ addictive, and it sparked the prescription pill crisis, which became the heroin crisis, which has become the fentanyl crisis.
There's no erasing the damage they did, but this settlement is major accountability.
It's another $150m for North Carolina, which brings us up to $1.6b for opioid-related settlements for our state.
Huge credit to my predecessor, Gov. Stein, who made this a top priority, as well as the team at NCDOJ who spent years fighting for this. They delivered.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0f6c31bc-7230-494d-a1e7-9b7e495a2fa1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
## **Smashing orange cones**
Last week, I got behind the wheel of a police vehicle and was given a simple instruction:
Don't hit the orange cones.
I was at the ribbon-cutting for the new driving track at our Justice Academy - the premier course in NC for teaching law enforcement advanced driving skills.
I've got a video below, but before you watch it, just give me some grace. It's a hard course. The washout rate is high, even among seasoned officers.
So did I smash some cones? Yeah, absolutely. But _eventually_ I figured it out and did okay.
And this is why I'm grateful to our Justice Academy instructors - they're training officers to hit far fewer cones than I did.
You can watch the video [here](https://substack.com/redirect/51ca9460-08ac-4ffd-bcd9-ef75125fbcb6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d569ae0d-76ba-4bec-8349-dca55ff4f7fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
## **The Lighthouse Fund**
This might surprise you, but here's the deal:
As things stand, millions of North Carolinians aren't going to hear from me again until the next election.
Why?
Because newsletters like this, social media, and local news just don't reach as many folks as you might think.
That's not ideal. I'd love to share with them the fights we're taking on, like this [video](https://substack.com/redirect/a8da1093-8579-4494-a40f-12e169ccc614?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from last week. I think they'd really appreciate it.
But we can't run TV ads this early. Can't afford it.
However, we _can_ run a monthly digital message (on YouTube, Instagram, etc.) to roughly a million people in NC.
That'd cost about $9,500.
So we're starting **The Lighthouse Fund.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a8f47fae-eb5d-49a1-912a-2f7b6e0ccce9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Once a month, we'll deliver a clear beacon to a large group of independent voters in the form of a targeted digital message.
The goal is to maintain a baseline level of awareness so that when campaign season gears up, we aren't starting from scratch with those voters.
Here's the math: If we can keep in touch with roughly 50% of independent voters for the next three years for under 2% of what we spent for our last campaign, that should produce a strong return-on-investment in a state where elections often come down to less than 1% of the vote.
To my knowledge, this hasn't been tried before - at least in NC. But with the number of voters you can now reach online, I think it's time for a new approach.
The most effective way to support this is a small, monthly donation - but of course, we'd also appreciate a one-time contribution. You can do either one **[here](https://substack.com/redirect/73efcda8-0757-4002-a4c0-5ac36b759056?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** (ActBlue) or **[here](https://substack.com/redirect/b6780e80-ead8-46e6-928d-653aa3048139?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** (non-ActBlue).
Thanks for standing with me.
Jeff Jackson

Hi team -- Elizabeth Warren here, reaching out on behalf of my friend Gabby Giffords. I have an urgent Senate update you need to hear.
Donald Trump and MAGA Republicans just included a provision in their “big beautiful bill” that would make it easier to buy dangerous gun silencers. Victims of mass shootings wouldn’t even hear their attacker.
This is sickening. And it’s a massive gift to the gun lobby at the expense of public safety. That’s why I’m reaching out to you today.
[**GIFFORDS is fighting on the front lines to stop this provision, and they could use more grassroots donations to stand up against the Trump administration. Will you join me in supporting GIFFORDS right now?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-june2025-warren.EX_suj&refcode=em250626-1-b&t=2&akid=10617%2E3935704%2EXiL3SF)
**[DONATE](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-june2025-warren.EX_suj&refcode=em250626-1-b&t=3&akid=10617%2E3935704%2EXiL3SF)**
Gun silencers make it harder for police to track shootings because they can’t figure out where the shots are coming from. Having even more silencers flood into our communities will only make us less safe. It’s common sense.
**But it’s clear Donald Trump and Republicans do not care. The only thing they want is to give tax breaks to their gun CEO buddies and help them profit even more.**
We are still debating this bill in the Senate right now, so you can bet that I will continue raising hell to remove this section from the bill. But I cannot take on this fight alone.
[**Will you make a $3 contribution to GIFFORDS before midnight? We cannot sit back while Donald Trump and Republicans try to turn back the clock on our progress.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-june2025-warren.EX_suj&refcode=em250626-1-b&t=4&akid=10617%2E3935704%2EXiL3SF)

But all our work comes with very real costs attached...

...and that is why I am asking you to make a _[tax-deductible donation](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74888&L=35348&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTY/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=&hash=6b7d730242d55e52186759e44e828acf66566736e1bae6f943796970e61717b5)_ today. [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74888&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)

With a caseload of nearly 200 lawsuits, Judicial Watch is leading on all these fronts...but _[we cannot carry forward our work without your help](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74888&L=35348&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTY/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=&hash=6b7d730242d55e52186759e44e828acf66566736e1bae6f943796970e61717b5)_.

name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: Not letting up this summer / Este verano no paramos
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Speaking out to secure the housing disaster recovery funds Houstonians deserve
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Houston%20disaster%20recovery%20funds%20protest%20June%202025.JPG]
We’re keeping up the pressure because our communities are worth it. On Tuesday, TOP and local housing allies teamed up to protest and demand that Houston Mayor John Whitmire and city council members increase the allocation for housing in the City’s Community Development Block Grant - Disaster Recovery (CDBG-DR) funds.
Our groups are calling for a total housing investment of at least $115 million in the $314.6 million relief funds package, and calling out Mayor Whitmire’s recent $50 million allocation as not enough. This demand comes as Mayor Whitmire welcomed HUD Secretary Turner to Houston, while the Trump administration positions itself to slash housing investments and upend disaster forecasting and response through attacks on FEMA and NOAA.
Houston’s housing crisis is made worse by increasingly extreme weather. Tens of thousands of Houston families are still living with damage from Hurricane Beryl and the 2024 Derecho, with several facing leaking roofs, structural hazards, and mold. For many, the next severe storm could bring even more destruction — because repairs and weatherization haven’t happened.
Working together, TOP and allies urged the Whitmire administration to allocate funding for housing in its initial disaster recovery plan, where an abysmal $0 in funding was dedicated to housing at the start. We'll keep you updated on this matter, as a pivotal vote on this funding package will likely take place in July.
For more information on this organizing effort, contact Damaris at dgonzalez@organizetexas.org [dgonzalez@organizetexas.org] .
Recommitting to the fight for reproductive freedom three years after the overturning of Roe
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Roe%20abortion%20protest%20image%281%29.jpg]
This Tuesday, June 24, marked the three-year anniversary of the Supreme Court overturning of Roe v. Wade. This devastating ruling cleared the way for Texas’s total abortion ban, where the real life consequences are no longer theoretical; they're fatal. Porsha Ngumezi [https://www.texastribune.org/2024/11/27/texas-abortion-death-porsha-ngumezi/] , Josseli Barnica [https://www.propublica.org/article/josseli-barnica-death-miscarriage-texas-abortion-ban] , and Nevaeh Crain [https://www.propublica.org/article/nevaeh-crain-death-texas-abortion-ban-emtala] died of sepsis after suffering delays in care while experiencing pregnancy loss. Their stories are part of a documented rise in maternal deaths and life-threatening infections that accelerated after Texas fully implemented its abortion ban following the Dobbs decision, as exposed in a landmark 2025 investigation by ProPublica. [https://www.propublica.org/article/texas-abortion-ban-sepsis-maternal-mortality-analysis]
Just this month, a new report from the Commonwealth Fund ranks Texas worst in the nation for health care access and affordability [https://www.houstonchronicle.com/health/article/texas-health-care-rankings-worst-20382031.php] . The crisis is hitting Black and Latino Texans hardest, from skyrocketing uninsured rates to avoidable deaths from delayed care.
In a joint statement with TOP, Shellie Hayes-McMahon, Executive Director of Planned Parenthood Texas Votes, said:
“This is what state-sanctioned neglect looks like. Women like Porsha, Josseli, and Nevaeh didn’t die because of rare conditions, they died because lawmakers criminalized standard medical care and created a culture of fear inside hospitals. The Dobbs decision gave Texas the green light to enforce its total abortion ban. What followed was a spike in sepsis and a rise in maternal deaths. We are now seeing the results: more maternal deaths, more preventable suffering, and a health system collapsing under political extremism. Texas can’t afford another year of this, much less another life lost. PPTV will make sure Texans remember who put these cruel policies in place—at the ballot box and beyond. This ban won’t go unchecked.”
Brianna Brown, Co-Executive Director of Texas Organizing Project, added:
“What’s happening in Texas isn’t an accident, it’s a strategy. A strategy to control our bodies, silence our voices, and abandon our communities. Black and Latino Texans are dying because politicians would rather score points than protect people. But we are not standing by. We are knocking doors, testifying, voting, and organizing until we have a state that values our lives, not just our labor or our pain. Texas belongs to the people, and we’re fighting like it.”
JULY 10 in Dallas:
Community dinner info session on local Inflation Reduction Act funds
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/03%20Community%20Dinner.JPG]
Dallas County is getting millions of dollars from the federal government to help lower energy bills, fix homes, and create good-paying jobs as a result of President Biden's Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) . But if we don’t speak up, that money could go to wealthy areas and big developers — not our communities. We’re organizing to make sure Black, Latino, and working-class families in Dallas get the support we deserve.
Join TOP on July 10 from 6 - 8 p.m. at the Beckley-Saner Rec. Center in Dallas for a family-friendly community event where we'll discuss how these IRA (Inflation Reduction Act) funds can benefit residents across Dallas County for years to come.
RSVP at toptx.us/ourmoney. [https://secure.everyaction.com/r5AdrDRdBEGm0Vv-N93R_w2]
For more information about this event and our IRA campaign in Dallas, contact Iman at ibouzid@organizetexas.org [ibouzid@organizetexas.org] .
TOP Tip: We'll be out next week. Follow us on social media.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Houston%20group%20shot%20disaster%20relief%20town%20hall%202025%20-%20final.jpg]
TOP offices will be closed Monday, June 30 - Friday, July 4 , as we take a moment to rest, rejuvenate, and prepare for an action-packed rest of 2025 filled with organizing. You can still keep in touch with us online, though. Remember to give TOP a follow on the following platforms:
Facebook [https://www.facebook.com/OrganizeTexas/]
Instagram [https://www.instagram.com/organizetexas/]
BlackTOP Instagram [https://www.instagram.com/blacktoptexas/]
TikTok [https://www.tiktok.com/@organizetexas]
Bluesky [https://bsky.app/profile/txorgproject.bsky.social]
X (Twitter) [https://x.com/organizetexas]
Español
Alzando la voz para asegurar los fondos de recuperación por desastres de vivienda que los habitantes de Houston merecen
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Houston%20disaster%20recovery%20funds%20protest%20June%202025.JPG]
Seguimos presionando porque nuestras comunidades lo valen. El martes, TOP y aliados locales en temas de vivienda protestaron y exigieron [https://www.houstonpublicmedia.org/articles/housing/2025/06/24/524826/trumps-housing-secretary-visits-houston-amid-protests-as-mayor-touts-resiliency-and-homelessness-plans/] que el alcalde de Houston, John Whitmire, y los miembros del cabildo aumenten la asignación de fondos de recuperación por desastres del programa federal CDBG-DR (Subvención en Bloque para el Desarrollo Comunitario Recuperación ante Desastres).
Nuestras organizaciones están exigiendo una inversión total de al menos $115 millones de los $314.6 millones en fondos de alivio, y denuncian que la asignación reciente de $50 millones por parte del alcalde Whitmire no es suficiente. Esta demanda se presentó mientras el alcalde daba la bienvenida a la secretaria del HUD, Marcia Turner, mientras la administración de Trump se posiciona para recortar la inversión en vivienda y desmantelar la respuesta a desastres mediante ataques a FEMA y NOAA.
La crisis de vivienda en Houston se agrava con los fenómenos meteorológicos extremos. Decenas de miles de familias aún viven con daños del huracán Beryl y el “derecho” de 2024, muchas enfrentando techos con filtraciones, estructuras inseguras y moho. Para muchas de ellas, la próxima tormenta severa podría causar aún más destrucción, ya que no se han realizado reparaciones ni mejoras.
TOP y nuestros aliados urgieron a la administración de Whitmire a incluir fondos para vivienda en el plan inicial de recuperación por desastre, que inicialmente no asignó ni un solo dólar a este rubro. Les mantendremos informados, ya que es probable que el voto decisivo sobre este paquete de fondos ocurra en julio.
Para obtener más información sobre esta iniciativa de organización, contacte a Damaris en dgonzalez@organizetexas.org [dgonzalez@organizetexas.org] .
Renovando el compromiso con la lucha por la libertad reproductiva tres años después de la revocación de Roe
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Roe%20abortion%20protest%20image%281%29.jpg]
Este martes 24 de junio se cumplió el tercer aniversario de la decisión de la Suprema Corte de revocar Roe v. Wade. Este fallo devastador allanó el camino para la prohibición total del aborto en Texas, con consecuencias que ya no son teóricas, sino fatales. Porsha Ngumezi [https://www.texastribune.org/2024/11/27/texas-abortion-death-porsha-ngumezi/] , Josseli Barnica [https://www.propublica.org/article/josseli-barnica-death-miscarriage-texas-abortion-ban] , y Nevaeh Crain [https://www.propublica.org/article/nevaeh-crain-death-texas-abortion-ban-emtala] murieron de sepsis tras sufrir demoras en la atención durante pérdidas gestacionales. Sus historias son parte del aumento documentado de muertes maternas e infecciones graves desde que Texas implementó completamente la prohibición tras el fallo Dobbs, como reveló una investigación histórica de ProPublica en 2025. [https://www.propublica.org/article/texas-abortion-ban-sepsis-maternal-mortality-analysis]
Este mes, un nuevo informe del Commonwealth Fund clasificó a Texas como el peor estado del país en acceso y asequibilidad de atención médica [https://www.houstonchronicle.com/health/article/texas-health-care-rankings-worst-20382031.php] . La crisis golpea más duro a las comunidades morenas y latinas, desde tasas altísimas de personas sin seguro médico hasta muertes evitables por demoras en la atención.
En una declaración conjunta con TOP, Shellie Hayes-McMahon, directora ejecutiva de Planned Parenthood Texas Votes, declaró:
“Así es como se ve la negligencia sancionada por el estado. Mujeres como Porsha, Josseli y Nevaeh no murieron por enfermedades raras, sino porque los legisladores criminalizaron la atención médica estándar y crearon una cultura de miedo en los hospitales. El fallo Dobbs dio luz verde a Texas para implementar su prohibición total del aborto. Lo que siguió fue un aumento repentino de la sepsis y de las muertes maternas. Ahora estamos viendo los resultados: más muertes maternas, más sufrimiento prevenible y un sistema de salud colapsando bajo el extremismo político. Texas no puede permitirse otro año de esto, y mucho menos otra vida perdida. PPTV se asegurará de que los tejanos recuerden quiénes implementaron estas crueles políticas, en las urnas y más allá. Esta prohibición no pasará desapercibida.”
Brianna Brown, co-directora ejecutiva de Texas Organizing Project, añadió:
“Lo que está sucediendo en Texas no es un accidente, es una estrategia. Una estrategia para controlar nuestros cuerpos, silenciar nuestras voces y abandonar a nuestras comunidades. Los tejanos morenos y latinos están muriendo porque los políticos prefieren ganar puntos que proteger a la gente. Pero no nos quedamos de brazos cruzados. Estamos tocando puertas, testificando, votando y organizándonos hasta que tengamos un estado que valore nuestras vidas, no solo nuestro trabajo o nuestro dolor. Texas pertenece a la gente, y luchamos como tal."

On Tuesday, TOP and local housing allies teamed up to protest and demand that Houston Mayor John Whitmire and city council members increase the allocation for housing in the City’s Community Development Block Grant - Disaster Recovery (CDBG-DR) funds. Our groups are calling for a total housing investment of at least $115 million in the $314.6 million relief funds package, and calling out Mayor Whitmire’s recent $50 million allocation as not enough. This demand comes as Mayor Whitmire welcomed HUD Secretary Turner to Houston, while the Trump administration positions itself to slash housing investments and upend disaster forecasting and response through attacks on FEMA and NOAA. Houston’s housing crisis is made worse by increasingly extreme weather. Tens of thousands of Houston families are still living with damage from Hurricane Beryl and the 2024 Derecho, with several facing leaking roofs, structural hazards, and mold. For many, the next severe storm could bring even more destruction — because repairs and weatherization haven’t happened. Working together, TOP and allies urged the Whitmire administration to allocate funding for housing in its initial disaster recovery plan, where an abysmal $0 in funding was dedicated to housing at the start. We'll keep you updated on this matter, as a pivotal vote on this funding package will likely take place in July. For more information on this organizing effort, contact Damaris at dgonzalez@organizetexas.org [dgonzalez@organizetexas.org] . Wade. This devastating ruling cleared the way for Texas’s total abortion ban, where the real life consequences are no longer theoretical; they're fatal. Porsha Ngumezi [] , Josseli Barnica [] , and Nevaeh Crain [] died of sepsis after suffering delays in care while experiencing pregnancy loss. Their stories are part of a documented rise in maternal deaths and life-threatening infections that accelerated after Texas fully implemented its abortion ban following the Dobbs decision, as exposed in a landmark 2025 investigation by ProPublica. [] Just this month, a new report from the Commonwealth Fund ranks Texas worst in the nation for health care access and affordability [] . The crisis is hitting Black and Latino Texans hardest, from skyrocketing uninsured rates to avoidable deaths from delayed care. In a joint statement with TOP, Shellie Hayes-McMahon, Executive Director of Planned Parenthood Texas Votes, said: “This is what state-sanctioned neglect looks like. Women like Porsha, Josseli, and Nevaeh didn’t die because of rare conditions, they died because lawmakers criminalized standard medical care and created a culture of fear inside hospitals. The Dobbs decision gave Texas the green light to enforce its total abortion ban. What followed was a spike in sepsis and a rise in maternal deaths. We are now seeing the results: more maternal deaths, more preventable suffering, and a health system collapsing under political extremism. Texas can’t afford another year of this, much less another life lost. PPTV will make sure Texans remember who put these cruel policies in place—at the ballot box and beyond. This ban won’t go unchecked.” Brianna Brown, Co-Executive Director of Texas Organizing Project, added: “What’s happening in Texas isn’t an accident, it’s a strategy. A strategy to control our bodies, silence our voices, and abandon our communities. Black and Latino Texans are dying because politicians would rather score points than protect people. But we are not standing by. We are knocking doors, testifying, voting, and organizing until we have a state that values our lives, not just our labor or our pain. Texas belongs to the people, and we’re fighting like it.” JULY 10 in Dallas: Community dinner info session on local Inflation Reduction Act funds [] Dallas County is getting millions of dollars from the federal government to help lower energy bills, fix homes, and create good-paying jobs as a result of President Biden's Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) . But if we don’t speak up, that money could go to wealthy areas and big developers — not our communities. We’re organizing to make sure Black, Latino, and working-class families in Dallas get the support we deserve. Join TOP on July 10 from 6 - 8 p.m. at the Beckley-Saner Rec. Center in Dallas for a family-friendly community event where we'll discuss how these IRA (Inflation Reduction Act) funds can benefit residents across Dallas County for years to come. RSVP at toptx.us/ourmoney. [] For more information about this event and our IRA campaign in Dallas, contact Iman at ibouzid@organizetexas.org [ibouzid@organizetexas.org] . TOP Tip: We'll be out next week. Follow us on social media. [] TOP offices will be closed Monday, June 30 - Friday, July 4 , as we take a moment to rest, rejuvenate, and prepare for an action-packed rest of 2025 filled with organizing. You can still keep in touch with us online, though. body:
Peter, The nonsense is continuing, and while I hope you are resting at the shore and beating this heat wave, we’re going to keep bringing you the nonsense updates you need and holding the lunatics’ feet to the fire
| | [ ]()

Peter, The nonsense is continuing, and while I hope you are resting at the shore and beating this heat wave, we’re going to keep bringing you the nonsense updates you need and holding the lunatics’ feet to the fire for it all. First, NJ Transit (and the Murphy Administration) continues to prove that the incompetence knows no bounds. If you’ve been waiting for the Bergen light rail extension, you’ve been waiting about 25 years. And you’re going to have to wait a few more. Is that because of engineering complexities or the cost of materials? Nope. That might be somewhat understandable. We’re waiting on NJ Transit to start a study. Federally mandated. That they were supposed to finish in August of 2023. But they haven’t started yet. And they’re going to hire a consultant to do it. When will that start? Mid-2026. And how many of these studies have they done over the last 25 years? This would be the fourth. (I have to give Politico a rare kudos for running [this](https://xtz223.keap-link016.com/v2/click/6790b516c05c871784a8995051b9c9f0/eJyNkE9vwjAMxb9Lzg1p0z9svSGEUFXGYdrOU9ZYIlASKzWUDvW7L2UTp03iZtk_P7_nKyOwylKlWcku9CVlyiLmoTFowNLSWVLNbSrzLEmTiLXGHtbenZCV1z-X78DUnufPRcRoQAjI2-tiWVfb9cem2taBROXDjYd0iuwpu-usXhbVho3jv8JwNLQ6B-2OleRPMCXSJqSid98GfkeEXSlE3_czdK0h07hZ447CQt-1QAS-m2q-DwUMHFs1fDp3EDKWuYgLIdMbigrBcw2KdlxZzUldoONxnCXzIkuCEYUIVv9-sYbhx874DWjPexA=) story). Oh, and what’s the projected cost of this project, by the way? A minor [$2 _billion_](https://xtz223.keap-link016.com/v2/click/fbb1bd5d0aea4793463a82af04f6b833/eJyNkE1vwjAMhv9LzqSBUhjrDSGEKhiHaTtPWePSsOBGibvSof73mW3itEm72o_fD18EAWqkwohcnOkjTadiJAKU1ltAWjVIuvzaprNsMp2MhLP4tglN60V--fX4BlzHd7P7xUhQ74GRp8flalvsNy-7Yr9l0uvAHv_SmWeL7KazflgWOzEMfwrDydL6nbWjyCm0cG1kLLei5-CYr4l8zJXqui7BY1I2J4XQRZWO05kaz1VTVba02kWJR0lBY7QkgzUQoqxCG3lEYKSO8hXCAVA6e6iZ0NZJOHOZaBuUkVrTSwNO9wy3SLxlh3lS08lxSu09oPl58Rb676zDJxMLhx0=). At this point, I think we should throw NJ Transit into the scrap heap of Trenton and start over. Next, justice comes...sometimes. Not often, but when it comes, oh is it satisfying. Last Tuesday, Bob Menendez [reported to prison](https://xtz223.keap-link016.com/v2/click/f42da0a34e36a403871b7d0995bfd434/eJyNkEFvwjAMhf9Lzg2BUtjUG0IIVQUO03ae2tRoEdSJHLOuoP73udvEaZN2smV_fk_PN8WAFXLRqFx98DVN5ypRBNYFB8hrj1zZr226yGbzWaLODk9b8peg8tuvx3dgHD8sp9NEcR9AkOen1bosDtvXXXEohQwVice_dJbZY3bX2exXxU4Nw5_C0DrevIt2VDnTBcZEjZNU_EJn4d-YQ8yN6bpuYuuI0MWJ9a2Rpvd0Gms0ta91CwjYwFUTBE8cNXsdyEWP-uhJR7EAtGDEswpB0J-HldB_Ow-f3yt2WQ==) to start his 11-year sentence. Will he serve all of it? I’m not holding my breath. But he betrayed the United States of America and We the People. So I hope he serves every miserable minute of it – and that he serves as a lesson to other power-hungry, corrupt lunatics who think they can get away with this kind of behavior. And I think we all know he isn’t the only one who should be serving a sentence. But I digress... Finally, I was sad to have missed the “Ask Governor Murphy” segment on New Jersey Public Radio. Because I definitely have some questions. And I know the Common Sense Majority for sure has questions. If he does it again, I’ll flag it ahead of time so we can be ready to bombard these lackey journalists with the questions New Jerseyans really want to hear answers to. But if you don’t want to wait, I’d love to hear from you. What would YOUR question be to Governor Murphy? Shoot it to me. Might be cathartic! Common Sense friends, we aren’t alone. We may not be the loudest voices, but we’re going to get there. Stay cool! For New Jersey, Elizabeth Nader

body:
Marrying John was one of the happiest days of my life, second only to the day marriage equality became legal for our entire country. | [ ](https://click.everyaction.com/k/110292870/553878130/1507790650?refcode=EM_FL_OPA_20250619_fr_juneteenth_team_oc_act_xx_hdr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vQ1BELzEvMTEzNTk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjc0NTE5MjFmLWEyNTItZjAxMS04ZjdjLTYwNDViZGZlOGU5YyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=KBcvwEb_9yyHsW5oqd9ehQLMFhMomcEqLJtPqdW8nGc=)
---
Ten years ago today, I was sitting in the Supreme Court fighting for my husband, John, and for queer couples like us across the nation. _**[Before sharing our story, I ask that you chip in to Equality Ohio and One Pennsylvania to help protect our freedoms.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/110292873/553878133/-254693044?refcode=EM_FL_OPA_20250626_ta_obergefell_surr_xx_act_xx_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vQ1BELzEvMTEzNTk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjc0NTE5MjFmLWEyNTItZjAxMS04ZjdjLTYwNDViZGZlOGU5YyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=KBcvwEb_9yyHsW5oqd9ehQLMFhMomcEqLJtPqdW8nGc=)**_ After ALS stole almost all of his physical abilities, I became John’s caretaker. After all, that’s what you do when you love someone. We began at-home hospice care out of concern over how John would be treated as an out gay man in a hospice facility. Even if we had been married, would they recognize me as his spouse in a healthcare setting? We had wanted to get married since the mid-1990s, but it became especially important to us as he neared the end of his life. Because marriage equality was not legal in Ohio, we flew to Maryland within two weeks of the Windsor decision striking down the federal Defense of Marriage Act. The day I took John’s hand in mine and we got married on the tarmac of a Maryland airport, was the happiest day of our life together. When we discovered the State of Ohio would refuse to list John as married or recognize me as John’s surviving spouse on his death certificate at the time he died, we started the fight that eventually became the Supreme Court case Obergefell v. Hodges. Although John died before our historic win, seeing how marriage equality has changed so many lives reminds me of him daily. **Sadly, the right to marriage we fought for is under attack, again.** Ten years later, anti-equality forces are attacking our rights like never before. In fact, they’re passing state laws and resolutions, trying to get the Supreme Court to overturn marriage equality. _**[Please split a donation between Equality Ohio and One Pennsylvania to make sure we can keep fighting back.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/110292874/553878136/-254693044?refcode=EM_FL_OPA_20250626_ta_obergefell_surr_xx_act_xx_l2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vQ1BELzEvMTEzNTk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjc0NTE5MjFmLWEyNTItZjAxMS04ZjdjLTYwNDViZGZlOGU5YyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=KBcvwEb_9yyHsW5oqd9ehQLMFhMomcEqLJtPqdW8nGc=)**_ | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

**You don’t have to take it from me. Just this year, the Idaho House passed a resolution urging the U.S. Supreme Court to reconsider the Obergefell decision.** Just a few months ago, the North Dakota House passed a similar bill. Supreme Court justices have also made it clear they want to overturn Obergefell and other decisions.
Even worse are the attacks on the transgender community, including in my home of Ohio, where transgender youth are subject to laws that have torn their healthcare away, removed their right to play sports or use the correct restroom at school and subjected them to a forced outing law, even when doing so puts them at risk of abuse at home.
I was lucky to love John, and our willingness to fight for each other – and our relationship – helped make the world a better place. I couldn’t have done it without more than thirty other plaintiffs and the attorneys who were part of Obergefell v. Hodges. It was a group effort, and that’s why we need your help today.
_**[Will you split a donation between Equality Ohio and One Pennsylvania to stand with me and defend LGBTQ+ Equality?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/110292881/553878143/-254693044?refcode=EM_FL_OPA_20250626_ta_obergefell_surr_xx_act_xx_l3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vQ1BELzEvMTEzNTk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjc0NTE5MjFmLWEyNTItZjAxMS04ZjdjLTYwNDViZGZlOGU5YyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=KBcvwEb_9yyHsW5oqd9ehQLMFhMomcEqLJtPqdW8nGc=)**_
We won because our community refused anything less than equality. We refused to live in a world where birth and death certificates could ignore our lawful marriages. We refused to live in a world where we were unable to say “I do” to the person we love.
Today, we refuse to live in a world where birth certificates are weaponized to deny our gender identity. We refuse to live in a world where a loving parent cannot make healthcare decisions for their child. It’s time for us to demand equality and justice again.
We know what life was like before, and we are NOT going back.
This time, I hope you’ll join me and commit to protecting our right to not only love, but to exist.
Love first, and always,
Jim

clean_body: Marrying John was one of the happiest days of my life, second only to the day marriage equality became legal for our entire country. | = Ten years ago today, I was sitting in the Supreme Court fighting for my husband, John, and for queer couples like us across the nation. = After ALS stole almost all of his physical abilities, I became John’s caretaker. After all, that’s what you do when you love someone. We began at-home hospice care out of concern over how John would be treated as an out gay man in a hospice facility. Even if we had been married, would they recognize me as his spouse in a healthcare setting? We had wanted to get married since the mid-1990s, but it became especially important to us as he neared the end of his life. Because marriage equality was not legal in Ohio, we flew to Maryland within two weeks of the Windsor decision striking down the federal Defense of Marriage Act. The day I took John’s hand in mine and we got married on the tarmac of a Maryland airport, was the happiest day of our life together. When we discovered the State of Ohio would refuse to list John as married or recognize me as John’s surviving spouse on his death certificate at the time he died, we started the fight that eventually became the Supreme Court case Obergefell v. Hodges. Although John died before our historic win, seeing how marriage equality has changed so many lives reminds me of him daily. Sadly, the right to marriage we fought for is under attack, again. Ten years later, anti-equality forces are attacking our rights like never before. In fact, they’re passing state laws and resolutions, trying to get the Supreme Court to overturn marriage equality. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = | = ---|---|--- = | = | = You don’t have to take it from me. Just this year, the Idaho House passed a resolution urging the U.S. Supreme Court to reconsider the Obergefell decision. Just a few months ago, the North Dakota House passed a similar bill. Supreme Court justices have also made it clear they want to overturn Obergefell and other decisions. Even worse are the attacks on the transgender community, including in my home of Ohio, where transgender youth are subject to laws that have torn their healthcare away, removed their right to play sports or use the correct restroom at school and subjected them to a forced outing law, even when doing so puts them at risk of abuse at home. I was lucky to love John, and our willingness to fight for each other – and our relationship – helped make the world a better place. I couldn’t have done it without more than thirty other plaintiffs and the attorneys who were part of Obergefell v. Hodges. It was a group effort, and that’s why we need your help today. = We won because our community refused anything less than equality. We refused to live in a world where birth and death certificates could ignore our lawful marriages. We refused to live in a world where we were unable to say “I do” to the person we love. Today, we refuse to live in a world where birth certificates are weaponized to deny our gender identity. We refuse to live in a world where a loving parent cannot make healthcare decisions for their child. It’s time for us to demand equality and justice again. We know what life was like before, and we are NOT going back. This time, I hope you’ll join me and commit to protecting our right to not only love, but to exist. Love first, and always, Jim = | One PA is a grassroots movement for racial, economic, and social justice in Pennsylvania.
