body:
I won’t sit by while they dismantle everything.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/110293300/553879645/1328794144?refcode=ea.2a6e096b-a252-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ms=ea.2a6e096b-a252-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJhNmUwOTZiLWEyNTItZjAxMS04ZjdjLTYwNDViZGZlOGU5YyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=KiDNP-j5UGYuRO-rRoK8LmKoPKKPpkYFyiXJLiGEC80=&emci=eabe0765-f051-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=2a6e096b-a252-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=4823105)
---
I know what it’s like to get the news. To sit in a doctor’s office, hear that awful “c-word” — cancer — and feel the ground shift beneath you. In 2022, I was diagnosed with non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma. I went through months of chemotherapy. But I was lucky. I had access to incredible doctors and effective treatments made possible by decades of medical research. I don’t take that for granted. Not for a second. This is why I can’t stay silent while Donald Trump and his administration work to tear down the protections that keep people from getting sick in the first place. They’re attacking the very science that saved my life. This administration is trying to slash hundreds of millions of dollars in medical research funding at the National Institutes of Health. They’re letting conspiracy theorists like RFK Jr. dictate public health policy and even pressuring scientists to erase references to mRNA vaccine technology from their research grant applications. These are direct attacks on life-saving science. And while this administration guts medicine, they’re also allowing corporate polluters to poison the air we breathe and the water we drink. **Trump’s EPA unleashed the most consequential environmental rollback in decades** with plans to gut pollution limits on coal plants, clean car standards, and climate regulations. The EPA Administrator Lee Zeldin said his goal, in his own words, is to drive **_“a dagger through the heart of climate-change religion.”_** If they succeed, Big Oil and corporate polluters will get a free pass to pump even more toxins into our environment, and the price we pay is measured in asthma attacks, cancer diagnoses, and lives cut short. This is why I’m staying in the fight. I know you’re tired, and it feels like hope is in short supply. I’m fighting those feelings, too — but despair is not an option. Cancer made me think even more about the time I have left and how I want to use it. **I don’t want to look back with regrets. I want to know that I did everything in my power to fight for the future — for our health and for the generations that come after us. That’s what keeps me moving forward. That’s why I refuse to sit this one out.** We owe it to our children and their children to demand better. We owe it to ourselves to end fossil fuel dependence and prioritize public health. clean_body: I won’t sit by while they dismantle everything. | I know what it’s like to get the news. To sit in a doctor’s office, hear that awful “c-word” — cancer — and feel the ground shift beneath you. In 2022, I was diagnosed with non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma. I went through months of chemotherapy. But I was lucky. I had access to incredible doctors and effective treatments made possible by decades of medical research. I don’t take that for granted. Not for a second. This is why I can’t stay silent while Donald Trump and his administration work to tear down the protections that keep people from getting sick in the first place. They’re attacking the very science that saved my life. This administration is trying to slash hundreds of millions of dollars in medical research funding at the National Institutes of Health. They’re letting conspiracy theorists like RFK Jr. dictate public health policy and even pressuring scientists to erase references to mRNA vaccine technology from their research grant applications. These are direct attacks on life-saving science. And while this administration guts medicine, they’re also allowing corporate polluters to poison the air we breathe and the water we drink. Trump’s EPA unleashed the most consequential environmental rollback in decades with plans to gut pollution limits on coal plants, clean car standards, and climate regulations. The EPA Administrator Lee Zeldin said his goal, in his own words, is to drive “a dagger through the heart of climate-change religion.” If they succeed, Big Oil and corporate polluters will get a free pass to pump even more toxins into our environment, and the price we pay is measured in asthma attacks, cancer diagnoses, and lives cut short. This is why I’m staying in the fight. I know you’re tired, and it feels like hope is in short supply. I’m fighting those feelings, too — but despair is not an option. Cancer made me think even more about the time I have left and how I want to use it. I don’t want to look back with regrets. I want to know that I did everything in my power to fight for the future — for our health and for the generations that come after us. That’s what keeps me moving forward. That’s why I refuse to sit this one out. We owe it to our children and their children to demand better. We owe it to ourselves to end fossil fuel dependence and prioritize public health. name: Nina Ahmad
subject: How I'm Working to Improve Philadelphia Right Now
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Nina for Philly
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ninageneral [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ninageneral]
Hi Friend,
I hope this Summer finds you healthy and rejuvenated! My year-to-date as your City Councilmember has been busy and productive. It’s been an honor to hear so many of your stories, hopes, and concerns as I’ve traveled all across Philadelphia.
As we've wrapped up this season of budget hearings and negotiations, my work continues on behalf of Philadelphia and I want to share a few specific things that I've been working on.
I'm proud to announce that I have secured $500,000 in the City Budget to combat Human Trafficking and launch the "Red Card Philly" anti-human trafficking campaign ahead of 2026's international focus on our city. We will be continuing to work on this comprehensive, multilingual awareness campaign to build citywide awareness and foster a culture of vigilance and prevention human trafficking across Philadelphia. Through "Red Card Philly," we are calling on every resident, neighborhood, and visitor to stand together agaainst exploitation . Please stay tuned for much more to come on this important ongoing project.
We celebrated the passage of my bill that ensures Electric Vehicle charging infrastructure is accessible and installed by properly certified professionals . This step toward supporting a cleaner and more sustainable future lays the groundwork for equity in environmental progress. I am invested in making Philadelphia a premier city for environmental sustainability and ensuring inclusion for historically underserved communities in our sustainable future.
This month, we kicked off an important round of hearings [https://www.instagram.com/p/DKkIEaMxTDv/?igsh=MTB6aHBpa3ZudzIzMw%3D%3D] that I have called for as the Chair of the Health and Human Services Committee on DHS and child welfare failures . I intend to get answers and demand change for the children and families of Philadelphia . I hope that you will stay engaged with this essential work to keep our children and communities safe and healthy.
This month, we also celebrate the passage of another bill I've been working on [https://www.instagram.com/cmninaahmad/reel/DG0UWhcRUtz/] that focuses on stepping up enforcement of penalties for vendors that sell e-cigarettes and vaping materials to our children . Vaping is not just a teen issue—it’s a public health crisis that demands action. I will continue working to ensure Philadelphia protects its children from this growing epidemic.
Finally, I'm thrilled to announce that we have secured $500,000 in the City Budget to improve access to healthy foods through Philly Food Bucks. This funding reaffirms our commitment to health equity and food justice in Philadelphia. Supporting proven, community-based solutions like Food Bucks is how we build a healthier future for all Philadelphians. [https://easternstates.heart.org/2025/06/18/philadelphia-city-council-approves-500000-to-improve-access-to-healthy-foods/]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP59/1/106735/images/IMG_1746.jpg]
Over the past few months, we have been diligently holding budget hearings and fighting for the improvements that our citizens are calling for. Thank you to each of you who has actively participated in this process . Your input and passion is being heard and we need you to stay involved!
It’s so important to me that I continue to hear your thoughts and priorities . I would love it if you could respond to this email to let me know how you think we are doing and where we should be headed. I need eyes and ears across the City and beyond in order to do my best work.
As always, I am endlessly optimistic for Philadelphia and deeply grateful for your support. I carry you with me each and every day.
I look forward to hearing more from you and ask for your continued partnership in the hard work of improving the lives of every Philadelphian. I know that we can do this together!
Thank you again,
Councilmember Nina Ahmad

**Scott Brown just announced he’s running to flip New Hampshire’s Senate seat red.**
If that name sounds familiar, it’s because he’s run for Senate — and lost — before. In Massachusetts. Then he ran here, hoping Granite Staters wouldn’t notice. But we did.

Now he’s back, with support from the national Republican machine, trying to buy his way into the Senate again. It’s up to our grassroots team to stop him.
[**Friend, split a $5 contribution now between my campaign and Jacky Rosen's and join the fight to beat Scott Brown.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110294139/553882092/-1148446775?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk5558-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyODM2YTNkMS1hMzUyLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=v6REo4ejWnQow6-_Tz9fJMrTW4EvQDsUu3ilIZ7kUrI=)

_But this seat doesn’t belong to Scott Brown._ It belongs to the people of New Hampshire.

I was born and raised here. I’ve run a family business, represented our communities in Concord and in Congress, and delivered for the people who call this state home — from lowering prescription drug costs to defending reproductive freedom and our democracy.
Scott Brown’s record is clear:
❌ He supports Trump’s MAGA agenda.

That’s not who we are. And that’s not who should represent us.

| | Hi [NAME], Did you hear about Trump’s Budget Bill that helps billionaires? It isn’t just numbers on a page—it’s a dangerous roadmap. This bill steals critical health care dollars from hardworking families in order to pay for massive tax breaks benefiting the wealthiest and well-connected. Friend, **Earlier this week, in a shock to the political establishment, our ally Zohran Mamdani won his Democratic primary for New York City Mayor.** This victory shows that we can defeat corporate and billionaire interests when they run a campaign that puts the people first. **Now, I’m proud to endorse another justice candidate, Denzel McCampbell for Detroit City Council.** I’ve worked with Denzel for a decade at the local and national level to advance racial justice, ensure our communities have the resources we need, and protect people’s rights (to housing, clean water and air, voting, due process, and more). Denzel cares about returning power to the people, and **as absentee ballots get mailed out to our district THIS WEEK, he is out knocking on doors and talking to everyday residents of Detroit.** I’ve gotten to join him canvassing recently (Denzel is on the left in front): [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsXu0R1XDWRVJnEMC9_ePsJYfTCgoXxVCxzBQjtX2I3-15AhkFYbwAaWuntpUSSI4Qk1tKHHB2Q4kCjwdv0if7sv87HGF82hAhRqll2Jojw4eLaCS3-bTb4fUXFocIKmh1hn6jOXqaJx5h1F-Nk50RaiMteJmmM4CmZ6EFxZZ9P9-wD5ygmYr2RPtE-avYAaKV7IucaGwd1KgjZ-fQC4pib82Ly8xxbuCHMq-1iWCfn0RaTDZOMEnrjeDDGxrWwVQe3NRlwsTRwR564dVToOyeNrLfCsv7UHF8WFjFU46M9yiwU755beXTKEEPZBomSWwqh9aYgz9wI02A8e8jAcxtJCdK0ySGf5Ddi3WswU0kRQrQ8EuPcv3AZsKx_h7vRRlgCT06YgxqLmKM7E1Rr-d-Nxh2SHprw3UnEv344gqnIEg/4ho/UZdMi_w1TluwIApPXnfrGQ/h1/h001.fW7u-NeZkGspnp27L9Pu5Q2lwrSWhEhG5xfucHpjJ_M) As a community leader who’s already served in public office and started social justice organizations, Denzel is ready to take on issues that our majority-Black city of Detroit has long faced—such as systemic disinvestment, unaffordable housing and unjust foreclosures, trouble accessing clean water, police brutality, and racist voter suppression. He’s up against opponents such as a State Rep who squandered our opportunity to pass progressive legislation while our state still had a Democratic trifecta. We know that he can win if he gets in front of voters early and often, but his campaign urgently needs our grassroots support. Denzel has served as my Communications and Political Director and now he advises my campaign. His support has already changed thousands of people’s lives through bold policies and strong constituent service programs.
He has also served our community through leadership in grassroots groups and as an elected Detroit Charter Revision Commissioner, where he led efforts to make our city's governing documents center the needs of residents.

clean_body: My colleague and comrade is knocking on doors and talking to everyday residents of our city. | | | Friend, Earlier this week, in a shock to the political establishment, our ally Zohran Mamdani won his Democratic primary for New York City Mayor. This victory shows that we can defeat corporate and billionaire interests when they run a campaign that puts the people first. Now, I’m proud to endorse another justice candidate, Denzel McCampbell for Detroit City Council. I’ve worked with Denzel for a decade at the local and national level to advance racial justice, ensure our communities have the resources we need, and protect people’s rights (to housing, clean water and air, voting, due process, and more). Denzel cares about returning power to the people, and as absentee ballots get mailed out to our district THIS WEEK, he is out knocking on doors and talking to everyday residents of Detroit. I’ve gotten to join him canvassing recently (Denzel is on the left in front): As a community leader who’s already served in public office and started social justice organizations, Denzel is ready to take on issues that our majority-Black city of Detroit has long faced—such as systemic disinvestment, unaffordable housing and unjust foreclosures, trouble accessing clean water, police brutality, and racist voter suppression. He’s up against opponents such as a State Rep who squandered our opportunity to pass progressive legislation while our state still had a Democratic trifecta. We know that he can win if he gets in front of voters early and often, but his campaign urgently needs our grassroots support. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately, with 100% going directly to Denzel McCampbell | | | | | | | | | | Denzel has served as my Communications and Political Director and now he advises my campaign. His support has already changed thousands of people’s lives through bold policies and strong constituent service programs. He has also served our community through leadership in grassroots groups and as an elected Detroit Charter Revision Commissioner, where he led efforts to make our city's governing documents center the needs of residents. As a future city councilperson, Denzel is committed to fighting for truly affordable housing, violence prevention programs to improve public safety, reliable and affordable public transit, and a transparent and accountable government that truly engages with our majority-Black city’s residents. He’s also a proud member of the LGBTQ+ community who joined me at Motor City Pride earlier this month (in the middle of the photo): Denzel has also been endorsed by a wide coalition of progressive groups including the Working Families Party, Metro Detroit Democratic Socialists of America, Michigan Liberation, Michigan United Action, Detroit Action, SEIU Michigan, UAW Region 1A, Metro Detroit AFL-CIO, AFSCME Council 25, and other unions.1 Thank you for continuing to fight for a government that truly serves the people, not corporate donors or billionaires. In solidarity and gratitude, Rashida 1 \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Rashida Tlaib** Date: Wed, Jun 25, 2025 Subject: I’m proud to endorse Denzel McCampbell for Detroit City Council To: dpwillis67@gmail.com Friend, New York City voters just voted overwhelmingly for Zohran Mamdani, who ran on a bold agenda to make NYC more affordable for families struggling right now in the city. What makes it even more special is that Zohran is an unapologetic pro-Palestine democratic socialist. He won yesterday’s Democratic primary election against a billionaire-funded defender of the genocide in Gaza and the fascist Trump administration. This victory belongs to all of us and shows that when a candidate has the courage to take on the political establishment and fight for justice for everyday people, we can defeat the billionaire and corporate interests that too often control our politics. We’re not stopping with Zohran’s win. This week, absentee ballots are getting sent to my district for local elections. And my long-time colleague and comrade Denzel McCampbell is busy knocking on doors and talking to constituents in his race for Detroit City Council. Denzel is also a member of the LGBTQ+ community, and I was honored to march alongside him at this month’s Motor City Pride (he’s in the middle): Like me, Denzel was born and raised in Detroit, is dedicated to public service, and believes that everyone should have safe, well-resourced, and thriving neighborhoods. As my former Communications and Political Director, his partnership in introducing bold policies and strong constituent services programs has already changed thousands of people’s lives. For over a decade, I’ve seen Denzel fight hard for equity and human rights—including the essential right to clean air and affordable drinking water. He helped found the Detroit Chapter of BYP100, where he led the fight against police brutality and mass incarceration. And as an elected Detroit City Charter Commissioner, Denzel led an effort to revise our city’s governing documents to center the needs of residents. Denzel is a member of the DSA Metro Detroit chapter. He’s pushing for a government that engages with and works for** allpeople, not just the powerful and wealthy... and he needs our help. Thank you for supporting this incredible grassroots leader. It’s no surprise to me that he’s been endorsed by a wide coalition of progressive groups including unions, the Working Families Party, Michigan Liberation, and Michigan United Action.1 Denzel is committed to fighting for trulyaffordable housing , protections for homeowners and tenants, mental health and violence prevention programs to improve public safety , resources and opportunities for young people and seniors , reliable and affordable public transit , an accountable government , and the well-being of everyday Detroiters. His opponents include a State Representative who single-handedly forced the Michigan legislature to end its session early—while we had a Democratic trifecta and while policies for water affordability, Black maternal health, and voting rights were awaiting a vote. We need representatives in government who are rooted in their community and who understand how urgently people need change. A lot of my most viral videos and stories come from asking a simple question of the media: "Did you check?"
Whether it's outing Max Miller's f[abricated story about being attacked on the highway](https://substack.com/redirect/4c1a3f8d-c302-447a-a03e-f1439d8637c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), testing the waters of Rock Creek Park [where RFK Jr. took a swim](https://substack.com/redirect/0dae7507-ff24-4396-8028-a77ac30f3e64?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), or calling out[ media reliance on misleading data](https://substack.com/redirect/b19c69c9-53da-4195-8cc9-cf8951779bcc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), doing the job journalists are too lazy to do has become a significant part of my social media content.
I can already tell I'm going to be doing a lot of checking when it comes to the New York City mayoral election.
Zohran Mamdani, who won the Democratic primary for mayor of New York City Tuesday, will be 34 years old for the general election in November.
His age has become yet another target for the media machine. Brazen and racist attacks are out in the open though seldomly echoed by mainstream media, but the constant mention of his age (and only his age) in headlines feels forced...

Gov. Mike Braun said the move involves all 15 of Indiana’s public colleges and universities and their various regional campuses. The institutions agreed to keep tuition and mandatory fees flat for in-state undergraduate students for the 2025-2026 and 2026-2027 academic years. Braun had requested a 0% increase last month and challenged the schools to “eliminate redundancies and identify ways to streamline services without compromising quality.” “The commitment made by all of Indiana’s public colleges and universities puts students and parents first and demonstrates to the rest of the country that Indiana is a leader in providing a high-quality education at an affordable price,” Braun said in a statement. State records showed this is the first time since at least 2010 that more than two campuses have kept tuition flat. ”It’s finally coming together that we’re within a state now that wants to balance out what that should be with parents in the drivers seat especially when you decided to invest in further education, post-secondary,” Braun said in an exclusive interview with FOX59/CBS4. ”Everybody took the challenge to start delivering us better value, make it a beacon for parents and students to look at when they do make that decision they’re gonna get a degree that’s got a job when you’re done with it.” Here are the participating institutions:
* Ball State University
* Indiana State University
* Indiana University Bloomington
* Indiana University East
* Indiana University Indianapolis
* Indiana University Kokomo
* Indiana University Northwest
* Indiana University South Bend
* Indiana University Southeast
* Ivy Tech Community College
* Purdue University West Lafayette
* Purdue University Fort Wayne
* Purdue University Northwest
* University of Southern Indiana
* Vincennes University

Per Indiana code, the Commission for Higher Education must make tuition and mandatory fee recommendations for state public institutions within 30 days of enactment of the state budget. The commission voted, for the first time ever, to unanimously support the governor’s recommendation to freeze tuition. “Keeping tuition flat keeps the door open for students of all backgrounds, all ZIP codes, and all walks of life,” said Samantha Fleischaker, the commission’s student member and a student at the University of Southern Indiana. “It sends the message that education is not just for one demographic—it’s for all people. It’s not just a number. It’s the difference between opportunity and what feels impossible.” The two-year annual tuitions are fixed from a low of $2,577 at Ivy Tech to a high of $12,144 at Indiana University-Bloomington, which is still below the national average of $12,201 per year.

Braun says | | Fox 59 Russ McQuaid, Matt Adams June 24, 2025 INDIANAPOLIS – All of Indiana’s public higher education institutions have committed to tuition freezes, the Braun administration announced Tuesday. Gov. Mike Braun said the move involves all 15 of Indiana’s public colleges and universities and their various regional campuses. The institutions agreed to keep tuition and mandatory fees flat for in-state undergraduate students for the 2025-2026 and 2026-2027 academic years. Braun had requested a 0% increase last month and challenged the schools to “eliminate redundancies and identify ways to streamline services without compromising quality.” “The commitment made by all of Indiana’s public colleges and universities puts students and parents first and demonstrates to the rest of the country that Indiana is a leader in providing a high-quality education at an affordable price,” Braun said in a statement. State records showed this is the first time since at least 2010 that more than two campuses have kept tuition flat. ”It’s finally coming together that we’re within a state now that wants to balance out what that should be with parents in the drivers seat especially when you decided to invest in further education, post-secondary,” Braun said in an exclusive interview with FOX59/CBS4. ”Everybody took the challenge to start delivering us better value, make it a beacon for parents and students to look at when they do make that decision they’re gonna get a degree that’s got a job when you’re done with it.” Here are the participating institutions: Ball State University Indiana State University Indiana University Bloomington Indiana University East Indiana University Indianapolis Indiana University Kokomo Indiana University Northwest Indiana University South Bend Indiana University Southeast Ivy Tech Community College Purdue University West Lafayette Purdue University Fort Wayne Purdue University Northwest University of Southern Indiana * Vincennes University Per Indiana code, the Commission for Higher Education must make tuition and mandatory fee recommendations for state public institutions within 30 days of enactment of the state budget. The commission voted, for the first time ever, to unanimously support the governor’s recommendation to freeze tuition. “Keeping tuition flat keeps the door open for students of all backgrounds, all ZIP codes, and all walks of life,” said Samantha Fleischaker, the commission’s student member and a student at the University of Southern Indiana. “It sends the message that education is not just for one demographic—it’s for all people. It’s not just a number. Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6jj4tjngb8ukwgx4odngvuvgks0qg4o6ts1raapitwk08lj3ds9305oaphy4qjlh23803vo1k88abh47jqlwnxzqdxdw9xpv8qtog56u9azmbybwiopq657socx89zomp3w2pa05kipz2b4q2fr1s&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=syh0lk&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=syh0lk&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=syh0lk&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=syh0lk&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6jj4tjngb8ukwgx4odngvuvhmfin63lr9fs8xdfjutz34r6jopwxb1gycdzyhuus8os918n6yqppe5i6doeebqdrn3ie4rs5h7ltkffel698t6u77w5n06sfn0o8uuma8h0i28pbvvnj2axhhx2xo&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=syh0lk&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=syh0lk&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: Team Pramila
subject: Zohran Mamdani just made history in New York 🗽
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Pramila endorsed Zohran because she knows we need leaders who don’t just tell us who to vote against, but who give us something to vote for.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20250626-5178-footer&t=1&akid=5178%2E420207%2E8XFqQ2)
**Peter, this week, a naturalized citizen, organizer, and bold progressive just beat the establishment political machine in the biggest city in the country.**
Zohran Mamdani will be the Democratic nominee for Mayor of New York City because he built an incredible coalition based on a real vision for working people to have a fair shot. He organized relentlessly around bold policies that will tangibly improve people’s lives, and refused to sell out his values. And together with other progressive candidates like Brad Lander, they built a cross endorsement strategy to beat the establishment.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20250626-1?refcode=em20250626-5178&refcode2=5178_420207_8XFqQ2&akid=5178%2E420207%2E8XFqQ2)
**Pramila is so proud to have endorsed both Zohran and Brad because she knows we need leaders who don’t just tell us who to vote _against_ , but who give us something to vote _for_.**
This victory isn’t just a win for New York. It’s a signal to the Democratic Party and to the country as a whole: It’s time for us to build a government that relentlessly focuses on making life better for working people and poor people — not the billionaires — and to not throw anyone under the bus as we do that.
Zohran’s fierce and joyful forward-looking campaign turned out people who felt inspired to vote for the first time, a multi-generational, multi-ethnic coalition that felt seen by Zohran’s authentic commitment to policies that lift them up — from rent freezes to universal health care to affordable food. That’s the stuff everyone needs day-to-day to thrive, not just survive.
But victories like this don’t happen by accident. They happen because candidates step up, volunteer organizers put in the work, and grassroots donors like you pitch in a few dollars at a time to fuel progressive campaigns.
**So if you’re fired up about what just happened in New York — if you believe we need more leaders like Zohran all over the country —[then please, pitch in $3 or whatever you can to help grow our progressive movement nationwide.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20250626-1?refcode=em20250626-5178&amount=3&refcode2=5178_420207_8XFqQ2&akid=5178%2E420207%2E8XFqQ2)**
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20250626-1?amount=3&refcode=em20250626-5178&refcode2=5178_420207_8XFqQ2&akid=5178%2E420207%2E8XFqQ2)**
Now is not the time to rest on our laurels. It’s time to keep building a movement that’s bold, unapologetic, and centered on the needs of everyday people, not billionaire donors.
In solidarity,
Team Pramila
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20250626-5178-footer&t=2&refcode2=5178_420207_8XFqQ2&akid=5178%2E420207%2E8XFqQ2)**

subject: Hearing directly from providers: Medicaid cuts will hurt
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Tina Kotek
body:

#

Last week, I traveled to Central Oregon to convene a roundtable of rural doctors, clinic administrators, family caregivers, and food security experts – all concerned about the impact of proposed cuts to Medicaid and SNAP. Every person had a similar message: "Cuts to Medicaid and SNAP will hurt people.” [_**The cuts to Medicaid would be particularly devastating for rural communities. I’m calling on Congressional Republicans to step up and protect the health care that 1.3 million Oregonians rely on. Will you add your name and stand up against these cuts?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110299366/553898742/1071112159?refcode=AU_TK_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20250626_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNmNlMTVmNC1hOTUyLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AUoMLy0EKc4VtA9getmVF8MpKwg73udUb-37Mf8GuVg=&emci=34ee00ee-a952-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=b6ce15f4-a952-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=15353729) | [SIGN ON](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110299367/553898743/1071112159?refcode=AU_TK_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20250626_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNmNlMTVmNC1hOTUyLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AUoMLy0EKc4VtA9getmVF8MpKwg73udUb-37Mf8GuVg=&emci=34ee00ee-a952-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=b6ce15f4-a952-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=15353729)

Rural communities, on average, rely more on Medicaid coverage than their urban counterparts because of things like more modest incomes, larger percentages of older adults, and fewer private insurance options.
When I left the roundtable, I wished that every single member of Congress considering supporting the bill to cut Medicaid and SNAP funding could have sat across from the folks I heard from. They are the people politicians were elected to answer to, not the ultra-wealthy who are getting tax breaks at the expense of the wellbeing of children and families.
I’m going to keep fighting, every day, for the 1 in 3 Oregonians who rely on Medicaid and SNAP.

| | My Dear Friend, [**My name is Maud Maron, and I need your help to defeat Alvin Bragg and replace him as the District Attorney of Manhattan.**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zadkam3o7l97hiov1bvvkabccaqethilul3aofao_rp22sh2s8i6epb0cjjm0pr4cjh2bs) You know Alvin... The George Soros elected, Pro-Criminal, Trump-Deranged DEI hire that has turned my beloved New York City into a third-world Hellscape.If you think that sounds too dramatic, just look at a few examples of what Alvin Bragg’s “weak-on-crime,” Trump-obsessed tenure has brought to the law-abiding citizens of New York:
---
* An innocent woman set on fire by a Guatemalan Illegal Alien who had already been deported at least once before...
* A mob of Illegal criminals caught on video assaulting two New York City Law Enforcement officers outside a “Migrant Shelter,” all **released without bail by Alvin Bragg!**

---
Instead of working for the last 4 years to make the Citizens of New York safe and secure, Alvin has been on a singular, sick, twisted mission and one mission only -- TAKE DOWN DONALD TRUMP.That’s what he ran on...Those were his marching orders from George Soros and his Radical donors...And those are orders he dutifully followed -- at the expense of not only those of us who live in New York, but every single American that deserved to vote in a fair election not tainted by a ridiculous set of trumped-up charges made up out of thin air.New Yorkers deserve better...Americans deserve better.That’s why -- whether you live right here in Manhattan, a thousand miles away in Des Moines, Iowa, or anywhere else in our great country -- I hope you’ll help me defeat Alvin Bragg. **[Would you consider helping my campaign with a one-time $28 contribution today?](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zgijc6qmjumac7tk7et3reqaof246kovhf5r2juo_rp22sh2s8i6epb0cjjm0pr4cjh2bs)** I could really use your help.Alvin Bragg has millions of dollars pouring into his campaign by the same Radicals who put him there the first time around...
---
* George Soros
* Hollywood Celebrities
* Elites right here in New York and Hollywood
* The deep pockets of the Democrat election machine

---
I don’t have any of that on my side -- but I hope I’ve got YOU on my side.To have any chance of beating the Democrat machine funding Alvin Bragg’s run for re-election, I need a nationwide army of Americans to rally by my side...A nationwide army of Americans who understand how toxic it is having a Radical like Alvin Bragg in charge of the criminal justice system of one of our largest cities...Who know how close Alvin Bragg came to knocking Donald Trump out of the 2024 Presidential election and what that would have done to our country... Who watched in disgust as Alvin Bragg conjured up a 34-count felony conviction against a man whose only real crime was trying to Make America Great Again!This is our chance to send a clear message not only to the people of New York -- but the nation -- that these Radicals put into place by George Soros to do his bidding are not invincible...That they CAN be defeated! Alvin Bragg is the perfect example of why I left the Democrat party.I think it all started when my 11-year-old got COVID... We were told to mask in the house and give my son meals in his room for 10 days. Instead, we cuddled up & watched TV together -- unmasked in the living room and ate our meals as a family at the dinner table. That was a watershed moment for me.What were we doing?When did the United States of America turn into a place where the Government told us how to live?When I dared to suggest that it may not be the best idea for biological boys to participate in girls’ sports, I was all but run out of town on a rail... Then I dared suggest that the complete failure of our school system might be due to something other than racism, I -- after a lifetime of considering myself a liberal Democrat -- was labeled a “Right Wing Extremist” by the New York Times!The blinders came off -- suddenly, I realized that if simply acknowledging the truth, calling out corruption and challenging the long-held beliefs of the Democrat machine disqualified me from being a Democrat.The truth will set you free -- and it’s an honor to represent you on the “Freedom Side” of the wall.I’ve been in their camp.As a former Democrat and as a mom raising four kids in Manhattan. I know how much they are getting wrong. And how bad it is for our children. **[That’s why I’m asking good folks like you to help me.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zc38arls836rhj28eq9e9rv365e2t3jma6rmhuro_rp22sh2s8i6epb0cjjm0pr4cjh2bs)** It’s going to take all of us to take down Alvin Bragg -- but this has been a season of political miracles!I humbly ask for your help today. I hope you’ll find it in your heart to send a one-time $28 contribution to help me pull off one more political miracle......and send Alvin Bragg back to obscurity where he belongs.He’s bad for New York...He’s bad for America...And he needs to go.One last favor...I know not everybody is going to be able to give that I write to today. **[So if you think you could spare a larger gift -- of $50, $100, $250, $500 or even $1,000 or more, a few of those would really help right now.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z1hvr7lmg8jbla5fg5k3mkvmsrt71ercueknt3ro_rp22sh2s8i6epb0cjjm0pr4cjh2bs)** We need a good, strong launch -- and without a few of those larger gifts, we’ll already be behind.Please just send what you can, My Friend.Just reading my email today is a tremendous favor, and I really appreciate it.Thank you, Wish Me Luck, and God Bless You!
---
---
**Maud Maron**

P.S. I guess Alvin Bragg has just been too darn busy to concentrate on the wave of crime and violence washing over New York...While he has spent the last 4 years prosecuting and persecuting President Trump, New York has become a third-world hellscape!New York deserves better...Our Country deserves better...

Will you help me take the place of Alvin Bragg by supporting my campaign to become the District Attorney of Manhattan?**[If so, please rush a one-time gift of $28, $50, $100, $250, $500 or even $1,000 or more -- I could really use your help!](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zqahbh8mhmbpnes49rvmu8rlv6d71963oceog2i0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0cjjm0pr4cjh2bs)**

body:
Please – for the sake of all our families

| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith,Please – for the sake of all our families – take it from me as someone who’s lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life... You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with “entertainment” that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace.But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue’s Clues_...
---
[](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z8asbk54nf4jco4ovussjck5j3bcufc6cd6c3tg0_rp22sh2s8i6epb0cjjm0pr2cph2bs)
---
| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to “educate” YOU about your “old-fashioned” and “mean” ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. **[Today, I’m inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zobpa5kqk3vlunrvq1vuiofsulensnffct12keco_rp22sh2s8i6epb0cjjm0pr2cph2bs)** Introducing: _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I’m making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you’ve seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we’ve already countered those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic “Story Hours” of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It’s encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we’re working to have that same impact in television.
---
>> Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we’ve already completed and released the first ten character-building episodes of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_! We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone – including folks just like you – who worked so hard to get us that far. But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we’ve made the first five episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE. That’s the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can’t get the word out. And the Left will try to bury _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 – and with the recent launch, we need to raise the funds immediately.
---
_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $250,000 for post production.**_
---
I know that’s a lot of money but it’s actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously, we won’t work through Hollywood.Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children.We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens must take over to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. **[That’s why I’m asking you to please contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, $2,500 or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $250,000 for advertising and $250,000 for Season 2.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z4sepmgid4i9rcr7n6att13rkicnhrg6gg49amj8_rp22sh2s8i6epb0cjjm0pr2cph2bs) ** As our special “Thank You” for becoming a **Founding Supporter** at the $50 level, we’ll send you all ten episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ FREE on DVD.This exclusive _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ DVD is only offered to **Founding Supporters**. It won’t be available for sale anywhere. So with **[**your gift of $50**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zeh0s120nlkcs7p6vjcmnbfe4b07tntjd7b4oq80_rp22sh2s8i6epb0cjjm0pr2cph2bs)** , you’ll be part of a small select group of people who own our wholesome TV show on DVD. You’ll have it ready to watch with the children in your life. Or you can drop your DVD by your local school, church, mission, or even leave it in the waiting room at your doctor’s office. So many children have no way of hearing God’s message in their lives. Your random act of kindness may change a child’s life. **[So please – whether you can send $50, $5,000, $25,000, or anything higher or lower, please respond quickly and know that gifts of EVERY size are needed and greatly appreciated.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zk58er5nf9m6rq946519sgdcp6iigv87a268609o_rp22sh2s8i6epb0cjjm0pr2cph2bs)** There’s no time to waste. Hollywood groomers have destroyed America’s Godly culture. But today we rebuild from the ashes.And it starts by ensuring the most innocent among us are filled with faith and family – not filth.Thank you for being a part of history by becoming a **Founding Supporter** of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.
---
Sincerely,

[**And if you feel the same way about what’s happening in California right now, then I need you to join my campaign.**](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j8-uoyAYR58GdzTwCagLF7bWTjKZZmInmXtnYxCwZSJi8U9z3_7GpumSw0l-35Fu7G33laNkjwBuVk8IAMUFArh_PlxY_rufJ1x_Fgbfxdnx7RcOL3WFtzwoye-_L_9YbeVUfAyHj7YPK33r89do3vJrdGectP1GkzLSedxpwiKT04STjIuEiuiW85RQ6ISWXCRC65gxJjqluZTMpJ3oIpsDAU4ECCo45WzHadsxY6RWLKUJB8TIc2cnnQlWSTrNDxmC926nvIv6_DbP4_Q8rEJQTUYtwezkYLSfN2Njs1kNvtl-9gPufMBXv5ow-ICBgEBQ0ZipNOMZzniSYcY4wW0bKyyT1qQtZZooheJqmV0z-SUog-JyX55wfTwjEBt2RtvFobg8_noRJd0o7XVAcfkqpM2-PDWXH4eiKc7V81Efz83lT1HjvzLU3rso5Hp82L63k0gQI9dn-da55vAdAAD__xbDlMk) Because after days of rioting, looting, chaos, and violence in Los Angeles, Governor Gavin Newsom finally addressed California and the nation in primetime. In a broadcast that—just like his term as Governor—was rife with technical difficulties, Newsom failed to explain anything and took no responsibility... **While Angelenos, Californians, and the nation watched, Newsom went on a deranged 8-minute rant, making excuses for violent rioters and looters, railing about saving our democracy, and calling Trump a tyrant.** You and I know the Truth: calling in the National Guard, restoring law and order, and protecting Los Angeles doesn’t make Trump a tyrant; it makes him the leader that California needs in this moment. The real tyrant is the man who has all but explicitly endorsed these riots for political gain...the man who shut down schools, small businesses, and churches for years...the most authoritarian governor in our nation. Yes, Gavin Newsom is the TYRANT. And this is all his fault. And if you and I don’t stand up and demand an end to 15 years of unchecked Democrat rule, then the tyranny will NOT end with Gavin Newsom leaving office in 2027. The insanity, the riots, the radicalism won’t stop until it IS stopped. **** **[That’s why I’m asking you to join my campaign today.](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j8-uoyAYR58GdzTwCagLF7bWTjKZZmInmXtnYxCwZSJi8U9z3_7GpumSw0l-35Fu7G33laNkjwBuVk8IAMUFArh_PlxY_rufJ1x_Fgbfxdnx7RcOL3WFtzwoye-_L_9YbeVUfAyHj7YPK33r89do3vJrdGectP1GkzLSedxpwiKT04STjIuEiuiW85RQ6ISWXCRC65gxJjqluZTMpJ3oIpsDAU4ECCo45WzHadsxY6RWLKUJB8TIc2cnnQlWSTrNDxmC926nvIv6_DbP4_Q8rEJQTUYtwezkYLSfN2Njs1kNvtl-9gPufMBXv5ow-ICBgEBQ0ZipNOMZzniSYcY4wW0bKyyT1qQtZZooheJqmV0z-SUog-JyX55wfTwjEBt2RtvFobg8_noRJd0o7XVAcfkqpM2-PDWXH4eiKc7V81Efz83lT1HjvzLU3rso5Hp82L63k0gQI9dn-da55vAdAAD__xbDlMk)** These L.A. riots were avoidable, and if I were Governor right now it would have been avoided. If we had proper leadership in this state, we would work WITH ICE and the Federal government to enforce immigration policy. We would have clamped down on the agitators IMMEDIATELY. Once you let a situation like this get out of control, it feeds on itself. Gavin Newsom knows this; but he let it happen anyway. He’s more focused on collecting sound bites for his foolish Presidential campaign than he is on keeping Californians safe. And as I said, the tyranny won’t end when he leaves office if we don’t demand real change. Would Kamala Harris handle this any better? Of course not! We need **_real_** leadership in California. That’s why I’m running for Governor. **[And it’s why I hope you’ll join my campaign today.](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j8-uoyAYR58GdzTwCagLF7bWTjKZZmInmXtnYxCwZSJi8U9z3_7GpumSw0l-35Fu7G33laNkjwBuVk8IAMUFArh_PlxY_rufJ1x_Fgbfxdnx7RcOL3WFtzwoye-_L_9YbeVUfAyHj7YPK33r89do3vJrdGectP1GkzLSedxpwiKT04STjIuEiuiW85RQ6ISWXCRC65gxJjqluZTMpJ3oIpsDAU4ECCo45WzHadsxY6RWLKUJB8TIc2cnnQlWSTrNDxmC926nvIv6_DbP4_Q8rEJQTUYtwezkYLSfN2Njs1kNvtl-9gPufMBXv5ow-ICBgEBQ0ZipNOMZzniSYcY4wW0bKyyT1qQtZZooheJqmV0z-SUog-JyX55wfTwjEBt2RtvFobg8_noRJd0o7XVAcfkqpM2-PDWXH4eiKc7V81Efz83lT1HjvzLU3rso5Hp82L63k0gQI9dn-da55vAdAAD__xbDlMk)** Friend, it’s not just the riots; EVERYTHING is falling apart all around us in this once great state.
---
* Crime is up.
* Homelessness is exploding.
* Public schools are failing.
* Housing is unaffordable.
* Businesses and families are fleeing.

---

Friends,
Senate Republicans are finalizing their version of the budget bill right now and are pushing for a vote this week. If the bill passes, it will come back to the House.
There’s still a lot of uncertainty about what the final bill will look like (and honestly, each iteration of this bill is worse than the last) – but this I know for sure:
Both versions of this budget bill are a cruel, immoral mess.
- Both bills would rip health insurance coverage from millions of people by making the largest Medicaid cuts in U.S. history.
- Both bills would take food off the tables of millions of families, kids, seniors, and people with disabilities by making the largest SNAP cuts in U.S. history.
- Both bills would increase the national deficit by trillions of dollars in order to give away trillions of dollars in tax breaks to the richest Americans and massive corporations.
I’m fighting this with everything I’ve got. But Republicans need to hear loud and clear that the American people won’t accept this.
Will you add your name right now to stand against the GOP’s dangerous budget bill before the next vote?
After you sign, please forward this email to three friends. The more public pressure we build, the harder it’ll be for Republicans to sell out our country.
Thanks for standing with me.
Sara

clean_body: [] Friends, Senate Republicans are finalizing their version of the budget bill right now and are pushing for a vote this week. If the bill passes, it will come back to the House. There’s still a lot of uncertainty about what the final bill will look like (and honestly, each iteration of this bill is worse than the last) – but this I know for sure: Both versions of this budget bill are a cruel, immoral mess. - Both bills would rip health insurance coverage from millions of people by making the largest Medicaid cuts in U.S. history. - Both bills would take food off the tables of millions of families, kids, seniors, and people with disabilities by making the largest SNAP cuts in U.S. history. - Both bills would increase the national deficit by trillions of dollars in order to give away trillions of dollars in tax breaks to the richest Americans and massive corporations. I’m fighting this with everything I’ve got. But Republicans need to hear loud and clear that the American people won’t accept this. Will you add your name right now to stand against the GOP’s dangerous budget bill before the next vote? After you sign, please forward this email to three friends. name: Deb Haaland
subject: The truth about all these emails
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO
body:
Every minute I get to spend meeting with voters out on the trail is precious.
# [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/133?t=1&akid=2849%2E400544%2EWBG-zx)
Good morning – it’s Deb.
I’m about to head out for another busy day on the campaign trail. Before I run out the door, I have a quick but important ask:
[**Will you chip in your first-ever $5 donation to our campaign to help keep me on the road?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250626_1_eoq?amount=5&refcode=em20250626-2849&refcode2=2849_400544_WBG-zx&akid=2849%2E400544%2EWBG-zx)
**The more grassroots support we receive through emails like this one, the less time I’m forced to spend calling donors over the phone to ask them to support our campaign.** With a schedule as busy as mine, every minute I get to spend meeting with voters out on the trail is precious.
We’ve had a packed schedule these past few weeks. Recently, I was honored to attend the Common Defense Roundtable in Santa Fe, where I proudly accepted the early endorsement of Common Defense, the country’s largest grassroots membership organization of progressive veterans.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250626_1_eoq?refcode=em20250626-2849&refcode2=2849_400544_WBG-zx&akid=2849%2E400544%2EWBG-zx)
_At the Common Defense Roundtable where we launched #VetsForDeb!_
Then, I spoke with union members at the Carpenters’ Union Central Labor Council. I was glad to meet some inspiring union members and discuss how the union way of life makes our economy strong.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250626_1_eoq?refcode=em20250626-2849&refcode2=2849_400544_WBG-zx&akid=2849%2E400544%2EWBG-zx)
I also proudly marched in this year’s Albuquerque Annual Pride Parade, where I had the opportunity to tell our LGBTQ+ friends and family: I see you, I’m with you, and I will never stop fighting alongside you. 🏳️🌈🏳️⚧️
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250626_1_eoq?refcode=em20250626-2849&refcode2=2849_400544_WBG-zx&akid=2849%2E400544%2EWBG-zx)
I cherish every minute I get to spend out in the community building momentum for our campaign and hearing directly from voters. **But that time unfortunately gets cut short when we fall behind on our fundraising.**
My ability to spend time out on the campaign trail is heavily dependent on the amount we raise through emails just like this one, so I must ask:
[**Can you contribute a $5 donation to our grassroots campaign for New Mexico before our end-of-quarter deadline on June 30? Every single dollar makes a difference as we keep showing up and organizing across our state.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250626_1_eoq?amount=5&refcode=em20250626-2849&refcode2=2849_400544_WBG-zx&akid=2849%2E400544%2EWBG-zx)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250626_1_eoq?amount=5&refcode=em20250626-2849&refcode2=2849_400544_WBG-zx&akid=2849%2E400544%2EWBG-zx)**
Be fierce,
Deb
P.S. The amount we’re able to raise through emails like the one you’re reading now determines how many voters we can meet and how strong of a campaign we can build to change the game for New Mexico. [**Will you keep my campaign team and me on the road by donating $5 before June 30?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250626_1_eoq?amount=5&refcode=em20250626-2849&refcode2=2849_400544_WBG-zx&akid=2849%2E400544%2EWBG-zx)
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_footer?refcode=em20250626-1&t=2&refcode2=2849_400544_WBG-zx&akid=2849%2E400544%2EWBG-zx)**
* * *
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with grassroots supporters like you. However, if you would like to change your subscription preferences, here are some options:
* [Receive Fewer Emails](https://act.debhaaland.com/signup/receive-fewer-emails-dh/?t=3&akid=2849%2E400544%2EWBG-zx)
* [Update Your Information](https://act.debhaaland.com/signup/update-your-information-dh/)
* [Unsubscribe](https://act.debhaaland.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe-dh/?t=4&akid=2849%2E400544%2EWBG-zx)

name: Tim Walz
subject: A promise I made nearly 30 years ago
disclaimer_text: paid for by Tim Walz for Governor
body:
In Minnesota, we protect the rights of LGBTQ+ people—we don’t take them away.
|
---
Peter,
In Minnesota, we protect the rights of LGBTQ+ people—we don’t take them away. **And as long as I’m Governor, every Minnesotan will be free to be exactly who they are and love who they love. **
It’s an honor to serve as Grand Marshal for the 2025 Minnesota Pride Parade this weekend. I couldn’t be more proud to march alongside LGBTQ+ Minnesotans from every region of the state.
This moment takes me back to a promise I made nearly 30 years ago, long before I held elected office. I was a teacher at Mankato West High School when a group of students came to me with concerns about anti-LGBTQ+ bullying. They asked for help starting our school’s first Gay-Straight Alliance.
My answer: _Absolutely._
We’ve come a long way since then—and we’ll celebrate that progress this weekend. But Pride also serves as a sobering reminder that our work isn’t finished. There are still those who want to turn back the clock.
**My promise: I won’t back down until everyone—regardless of who they are or who they love—can live freely and equally. **
Happy Pride,
Tim Walz
** **

body:

| | | | |
---
| Letter from the Chair
---
When running for NEGOP Chair, I often spoke of the need for leadership development to "build our bench" in the Republican Party. Some are born leaders, but most are developed with time, effort, and experience.
Spending time helping others to learn new things and to build new skill sets is time well spent. Towards that end, the NEGOP has already hosted one well-attended Campaign and Candidate training day with the help of the Leadership Institute.
In July the NEGOP will lead a half-day retreat for our county leaders for more learning and networking. In addition, a full day of Campaign and Candidate training led by the Republican National Committee State Strategies will be held the following day. Other opportunities will be forthcoming in the next few months including social media training, Parliamentarian training, and much more.
Experiential learning is also being done at all levels of our party as our committees are organizing, planning, and executing our political and legislative strategies. The world of politics and campaigning changes rapidly and we will prepare ourselves for those changes as we all continue to learn and grow.
I am honored to lead this organization and to oversee the transformation around me. Just as I stand on the shoulders of those who came before me, I will add to the foundation for those who follow. And thank you all for your support as we work to elect well-prepared Republicans and to become better leaders in our communities.
Mary Jane Truemper Chairman, Nebraska Republican Party
---
---
| |
---
---
| |
# What's Happening...
---
Candidate Recruitment
The 2026 primary filing deadline is less than a year away, and the NEGOP is actively partnering with county parties across Nebraska to recruit strong Republican candidates for federal, statewide, legislative, and multi-county offices. Candidates are already beginning to announce their campaigns, and the NEGOP is committed to ensuring they are equipped with the tools and training needed to succeed. To support this effort, the NEGOP recently partnered with the Leadership Institute to host a Campaign & Candidate Workshop, a full-day, hands-on training designed to help aspiring leaders build and run effective campaigns. Attendees gained a foundational understanding of campaign strategy and left with actionable steps they can apply immediately.
As more candidates step forward, the NEGOP will continue offering training opportunities. Candidates, campaign managers, and staff are encouraged to attend our upcoming Campaign & Candidate School on July 26th in Lincoln. This full-day training, hosted in partnership with the RNC, will provide practical guidance on organizing, fundraising, voter outreach, and more.
If you or someone you know is considering a run for office -- or would make a strong candidate, please contact our Political Director, Joe Hagerty, at political@ne.gop.

clean_body: News, events, and action items to keep Nebraska red and growing strong. | | | | | | Letter from the Chair When running for NEGOP Chair, I often spoke of the need for leadership development to "build our bench" in the Republican Party. Some are born leaders, but most are developed with time, effort, and experience. Spending time helping others to learn new things and to build new skill sets is time well spent. Towards that end, the NEGOP has already hosted one well-attended Campaign and Candidate training day with the help of the Leadership Institute. In July the NEGOP will lead a half-day retreat for our county leaders for more learning and networking. In addition, a full day of Campaign and Candidate training led by the Republican National Committee State Strategies will be held the following day. Other opportunities will be forthcoming in the next few months including social media training, Parliamentarian training, and much more. Experiential learning is also being done at all levels of our party as our committees are organizing, planning, and executing our political and legislative strategies. The world of politics and campaigning changes rapidly and we will prepare ourselves for those changes as we all continue to learn and grow. I am honored to lead this organization and to oversee the transformation around me. Just as I stand on the shoulders of those who came before me, I will add to the foundation for those who follow. And thank you all for your support as we work to elect well-prepared Republicans and to become better leaders in our communities. Mary Jane Truemper Chairman, Nebraska Republican Party | | | | What's Happening... Candidate Recruitment The 2026 primary filing deadline is less than a year away, and the NEGOP is actively partnering with county parties across Nebraska to recruit strong Republican candidates for federal, statewide, legislative, and multi-county offices. Candidates are already beginning to announce their campaigns, and the NEGOP is committed to ensuring they are equipped with the tools and training needed to succeed. To support this effort, the NEGOP recently partnered with the Leadership Institute to host a Campaign & Candidate Workshop, a full-day, hands-on training designed to help aspiring leaders build and run effective campaigns. Attendees gained a foundational understanding of campaign strategy and left with actionable steps they can apply immediately. As more candidates step forward, the NEGOP will continue offering training opportunities. Candidates, campaign managers, and staff are encouraged to attend our upcoming Campaign & Candidate School on July 26th in Lincoln. This full-day training, hosted in partnership with the RNC, will provide practical guidance on organizing, fundraising, voter outreach, and more. Derek,
It’s been difficult to keep up with everything that’s in this “big, beautiful” GOP budget bill — and to be frank, there are too many bad elements of the bill to fit into one email.
But I’m sharing a list below of five crazy facts about this bill that Virginians should know right now. If this bill passes — and it could be up for a vote in the Senate in a matter of days — here’s what’s at stake:
Fact #1:
Thousands of Virginians would lose their health insurance due to the massive cuts to Medicaid and the cuts to the tax breaks that help Virginians afford insurance under the Affordable Care Act.
Fact #2:
Over 200,000 Virginians — including kids — would lose access to SNAP, an essential nutrition assistance program that helps families access healthy foods.
Fact #3:
It would roll back key provisions in the Inflation Reduction Act that are creating tens of thousands of jobs in the Commonwealth and helping to lower our energy bills.
Fact #4:
Not only would the bill cut key programs for working families, it would raise taxes for these families, too, while cutting taxes for the super wealthy.
Fact #5:
Despite all these insane cuts, the bill would actually ADD $3.8 trillion to the deficit (which is one of the reasons we’re seeing fighting between different factions in the Republican party right now).
One of the best ways you can help us fight back against this bill is by talking with your friends, family, and neighbors about what’s at stake.
Write letters to the editor, post online, and share this email.
When more people start speaking out about this, the more likely folks are to join in.
I’m doing everything I can to fight back against this terrible budget, and if you’re with me, I’d love to hear from you. Please sign on today to say NO to the extreme GOP budget. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/FsILE_M7_Um5hpfO-vKVBQ2]
Thanks for your support.
-Tim

If this bill passes — and it could be up for a vote in the Senate in a matter of days — here’s what’s at stake: Fact #1: Thousands of Virginians would lose their health insurance due to the massive cuts to Medicaid and the cuts to the tax breaks that help Virginians afford insurance under the Affordable Care Act. Fact #2: Over 200,000 Virginians — including kids — would lose access to SNAP, an essential nutrition assistance program that helps families access healthy foods. Fact #3: It would roll back key provisions in the Inflation Reduction Act that are creating tens of thousands of jobs in the Commonwealth and helping to lower our energy bills. Fact #4: Not only would the bill cut key programs for working families, it would raise taxes for these families, too, while cutting taxes for the super wealthy. Fact #5: Despite all these insane cuts, the bill would actually ADD $3.8 trillion to the deficit (which is one of the reasons we’re seeing fighting between different factions in the Republican party right now). One of the best ways you can help us fight back against this bill is by talking with your friends, family, and neighbors about what’s at stake. Write letters to the editor, post online, and share this email. When more people start speaking out about this, the more likely folks are to join in. I’m doing everything I can to fight back against this terrible budget, and if you’re with me, I’d love to hear from you. Please sign on today to say NO to the extreme GOP budget. [] Thanks for your support. -Tim [] Paid for by Kaine for Virginia 1490-5A Quarterpath Road #272 Williamsburg, VA 23185 Emails like this one are a critical part of staying in touch during this important election year. We value your support, and are so glad to have you on the team. If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please unsubscribe: .

name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: Obergefell v. Hodges
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE
body:
| I won’t stop fighting until every person can live freely, openly, and authentically.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=4842%2E35263%2ElFKK-c)
Peter — 10 years ago today, the Supreme Court made marriage equality the law of the land in the decision _Obergefell v. Hodges_. This ruling from 2015, that marriage is a fundamental right for every couple, was the culmination of decades of hard work from activists fighting for equal rights. Together, we were able to further enshrine marriage equality into federal law with the passage of my bill, the _Respect for Marriage Act_. It passed with bipartisan support, and it’s one of my proudest accomplishments. But Peter, despite all of this progress, attacks on LGBTQ+ rights are rampant across the country.

Republican-led state legislatures across the country have only become more emboldened under Donald Trump’s presidency. Republican lawmakers in nine states have already proposed at least one piece of legislation that targets marriage equality. Despite the attacks, I promise to keep up the fight for LGBTQ+ rights until every person can live freely, openly, and authentically. So this past weekend, Donald Trump unconstitutionally ordered U.S. warplanes to strike three of Iran’s nuclear sites... Then he shouted “peace!” —as if bombs create diplomacy.
You cannot bomb your way to peace. This was a reckless act of escalation. This is chaos disguised as leadership. And it’s not just dangerous, it’s illegal.
Under our Constitution, only Congress has the power to authorize war. But once again, Trump has taken us to the brink of war—this time with Iran, a sovereign nation—without provocation from them, without Congressional approval, and without the consent of the people.
And for what? For power, for oil, for defense contracts—and yes, for Israel’s far-right leadership.
This is not our war.
It’s a war to enrich weapons manufacturers. It’s a war waged by oligarchs, for oligarchs. And working people— our communities —are the ones who pay the price.
I founded Politivist Action PAC because we need leaders in Congress who won’t sell out to the war machine. We need leaders who will fight to stop endless war, defend our Constitution, and stand up to both parties when they serve corporate interests over human lives.
Right now, there’s a bipartisan war powers resolution in the House—and the Senate has also followed suit with a companion bill—that would force Trump to get congressional approval before launching more attacks on Iran. That’s quite literally how our system is supposed to work.
So far, only 73 members support the resolution. Out of 535. 72 Democrats. 1 Republican–the sponsor of the Senate bill.
Why? Because the silent leaders are not anti-war. And they’re not anti-oligarchy.

name: Scott Brown
subject: I have something personal to share with you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Scott Brown for New Hampshire, Inc
body:
Friend,

MY NAME IS SCOTT BROWN, AND I WANT TO TAKE A FEW MINUTES TO SHARE MY
STORY WITH YOU AND HOW THE EXPERIENCES AND LESSONS I’VE LEARNED HAVE
LED ME TO MAKE A BIG DECISION THIS WEEK.

I had a challenging upbringing. My mom was married and divorced four
times, and my dad was married and divorced three times. I was raised
by my single mom, who worked multiple jobs to put food on the table.
We didn’t have much, but with the love and support of my
grandparents, we had a fighting chance. We moved often—I lived in 17
different places before I turned 18.

#
[https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/bio-brown-hf-launch-amc/?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_amc&utm_campaign=20250625_bio-launch_sb&utm_term=lrm-active]

I know what it’s like to worry about where your next meal is coming
from or whether the bills all get paid. _And those early years taught
me the value of grit, of resilience, and hard work._

NOTHING IN MY LIFE HAS EVER BEEN HANDED TO ME — I’VE HAD TO FIGHT
FOR EVERY STEP FORWARD.

I worked my way through college and law school, taking any odd job and
doing whatever it took to stay afloat.

At 19, I joined the Army National Guard. I served for more than 30
years and retired as a Colonel. I’ve worn our nation’s uniform
with pride and know firsthand what it means to serve a cause bigger
than yourself.

#
[https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/bio-brown-hf-launch-amc/?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_amc&utm_campaign=20250625_bio-launch_sb&utm_term=lrm-active]
Back in 2010, I took a leap that many thought was crazy. I ran for the
U.S. Senate in Massachusetts as a Republican, _driven by a belief that
people like you deserved a real voice in Washington, not just another
career politician._ I drove across the state, putting countless miles
on my beloved truck, a 2005 GMC Canyon. With the incredible support of
grassroots supporters like you from all corners of the country, we
pulled off a stunning upset and won, shaking the political
establishment to its core.

But that victory was just the start.

I went to Washington as a disruptor, _refusing to play the insider
games of career politicians._ That made me a target. The national
Democrats zeroed in, recruiting Elizabeth Warren and pouring tens of
millions into a campaign to defeat me. Despite our best efforts, we
came up short in that race.

BUT I WASN’T DISCOURAGED. I BELIEVED THEN, AND I BELIEVE NOW, THAT
THERE’S A BIGGER PLAN FOR ALL OF US.

My wife, Gail, and I became four-time grandparents, and we’ve poured
our hearts into our family and our New Hampshire community. In 2017,
when President Trump asked me to serve as U.S. Ambassador to New
Zealand and Samoa, _I was honored to represent our nation, strengthen
global partnerships, and protect American interests abroad._
[https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/bio-brown-hf-launch-amc/?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_amc&utm_campaign=20250625_bio-launch_sb&utm_term=lrm-active]

#
[https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/bio-brown-hf-launch-amc/?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_amc&utm_campaign=20250625_bio-launch_sb&utm_term=lrm-active]

Today, I’m writing to you with big news: I’M NOT DONE FIGHTING.
Our country’s future is at a crossroads, and I’m stepping up again
to run for the U.S. Senate in New Hampshire. I’M DOING THIS FOR YOU,
FOR OUR SHARED VALUES, AND FOR THE AMERICA WE BELIEVE IN.
Chip in to Join Scott Brown »
[https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/bio-brown-hf-launch-amc/?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_amc&utm_campaign=20250625_bio-launch_sb&utm_term=lrm-active]

You’ve seen what happens when Democrats hold unchecked power...

Runaway inflation...

Chaos at our southern border...

Soft-on-crime policies...

Men in women’s sports and locker rooms...

Foreign policy missteps that weaken our allies and embolden our
enemies.

Hardworking Americans like you are being left behind, and we can’t
let this radical agenda take over the Senate in 2026. THE STAKES ARE
JUST TOO HIGH.

Here’s the truth: _I can’t do this without you._

The Democrats and their elite allies will flood this race with
MILLIONS. It’s an open seat in a swing state. They don’t want
someone like me—someone who speaks plainly, serves with honor, and
refuses to sell out—anywhere near Washington.

That’s why I’m reaching out to you today, asking you to stand with
me from Day One.

A CONTRIBUTION OF $5, $10, OR WHATEVER YOU CAN GIVE WILL HELP US BUILD
A CAMPAIGN POWERED BY PEOPLE LIKE YOU, NOT POLITICAL INSIDERS.
[https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/bio-brown-hf-launch-amc/?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_amc&utm_campaign=20250625_bio-launch_sb&utm_term=lrm-active]
Every dollar counts, and every voice matters.
Chip in to Join Scott Brown »
[https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/bio-brown-hf-launch-amc/?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_amc&utm_campaign=20250625_bio-launch_sb&utm_term=lrm-active]

If you’ve ever felt like your voice doesn’t matter, I’m here to
tell you it does. It matters to me. And it’s the only reason I’m
in this fight.

Let’s do this together.

Scott Brown
Candidate for U.S. Senate
New Hampshire
Chip in to Join Scott Brown »
[https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/bio-brown-hf-launch-amc/?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_amc&utm_campaign=20250625_bio-launch_sb&utm_term=lrm-active]

Hardworking Americans like you are being left behind, and we can’t let this radical agenda take over the Senate in 2026. THE STAKES ARE JUST TOO HIGH. Here’s the truth: I can’t do this without you. That’s why I’m reaching out to you today, asking you to stand with me from Day One.
