name: MassDems
subject: Reproductive Freedom Is Under Attack. We’re Fighting Back.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Massachusetts Democratic State Committee
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Logo.png]
Peter,
In the three years since Dobbs v. Jackson overturned federal abortion protections, the Supreme Court has continued to chip away at reproductive rights. Just today, a new ruling gave states even more power to defund abortion providers like Planned Parenthood. While states across the country move to restrict access to care, Massachusetts is fighting back—protecting patients, providers, and the fundamental right to make personal health decisions.
WHAT THE SUPREME COURT OVERTURNED IN DOBBS V. JACKSON WOMEN’S HEALTH ORGANIZATION
In 1973, the Supreme Court ruled that the 14th Amendment’s guarantee of privacy included a woman’s right to abortion. That precedent stood for nearly 50 years, until June 24, 2022, when the Court’s ruling in Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization erased federal protections for abortion access. The decision gave states sweeping power to ban or restrict abortion, even in cases where a woman’s life or health is at risk.
The conservative majority, which includes Justices Gorsuch, Kavanaugh, Barrett, Thomas, and Alito, with Chief Justice Roberts concurring in part, ruled that the Constitution does not guarantee access to abortion. Since then, many states have enacted extreme laws that restrict not only abortion, but also care for miscarriages, ectopic pregnancies, and non-viable pregnancies.
Just today, June 26, 2025, the Supreme Court doubled down. In Medina v. Planned Parenthood South Atlantic , the Court upheld South Carolina’s right to deny Medicaid funding to abortion providers like Planned Parenthood, redirecting those funds to what the state calls “real, comprehensive healthcare.” This ruling gives other states a green light to defund reproductive health providers under the banner of “stewarding resources,” a move that threatens care access for millions of low-income women. The decision also shows how far the Court has moved from protecting reproductive freedom to enabling states to dismantle it systematically.
HOW MASSACHUSETTS WILL PROTECT WOMEN’S HEALTH
In a recent public statement, Governor Maura Healey was unequivocal: “Reproductive freedom is not negotiable here in Massachusetts. Massachusetts will always lead the way on protecting women's health.”
Attorney General Andrea Campbell, standing with other Attorneys General to defend medical professionals from targeted attacks, said: “As threats against providers of abortion and gender-affirming care continue to escalate, it is incumbent upon all of us to double down on our efforts to champion, defend, and protect the medical professionals who provide this essential health care.”
In response to ongoing attacks on health care, the Massachusetts Senate will likely be voting on Bill S.2522, “ An Act Strengthening Health Care Protections in the Commonwealth .” This bill strengthens protections for reproductive and gender-affirming care, building on Chapter 127 of the Acts of 2022. It safeguards the personal information and licensure of providers, advocates, and legal counsel involved in such care, and blocks state cooperation with out-of-state or federal investigations into legally protected health services in Massachusetts. It restricts data collection and sharing by the Department of Public Health and limits access to electronic health records by out-of-state entities. The bill also requires hospitals to provide emergency care to all patients and bans insurance discrimination against nonprofits that offer reproductive or gender-affirming care or face abusive litigation.
While other states use the courts to defund and criminalize reproductive care, Massachusetts will continue to invest in it. The MassDems stand as a partner in the ongoing fight to protect the rights, safety, and dignity of every patient and provider.
With care,
The MassDems Team

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2297%2E135344%2EkyciGS)

Friends -
Today, I gave a speech, taking my stab at an affirmative economic agenda for America. Despite the daily onslaught from the Trump Administration, I believe we need to offer a different vision, and demonstrate our positive plan for our country. As an elected leader, I feel as though I have the responsibility to treat the moment with the seriousness it deserves.
**You can watch the full speech here:**[**https://x.com/i/broadcasts/1RDGlzQZAXDxL**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/3802?t=2&akid=2297%2E135344%2EkyciGS)
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/3795?t=3&akid=2297%2E135344%2EkyciGS)
**That economic vision is centered around one reality: Our country’s shrinking middle class is the singular security threat facing the nation. Our most pressing security threat isn’t coming from overseas. And this one is existential to America.**
That’s why, as a CIA Analyst and Pentagon official by training, I laid out my Economic War Plan for America. Because any successful vision for America starts with an economy that works for everyone.
This plan starts with laying out the specific problem we are trying to solve. The American middle class is shrinking. That’s not a political statement, it’s a fact. And politicians in both parties have let their priorities stray from the middle class.
And my plan aims not just to fix the broken systems or nibble at them around the margins, but to rebuild them. I am calling for action on jobs (especially focused around the rapid change AI is going to bring); education; housing; energy; healthcare; and serious political reform.
As Michigan’s Senator, who won on the same ticket as President Trump, I believe there are also some sacred cows that have to be slaughtered – old ideas where the Democratic Party needs to adapt and change. But the truth is you can’t fight something with nothing – and Democrats need to offer something positive and play some offense in order to win.
I hope you’ll join me.
Elissa

**June 5, 2018.**
Do you remember it? I'll never forget it — that was the day we launched our first campaign for Congress.
The truth is, I had no idea what to expect.
I knew we had a large number of supporters who would be willing to commit the time and hard work needed to run a campaign of that magnitude, but I also knew that one of the biggest challenges we'd face would be funding a winning campaign.
But because of supporters like you, that was never in doubt. We were able to organize and mobilize our movement in Minnesota's 5th district, fighting off unprecedented right-wing attacks and outside spending along the way.
Two years later in 2020 we did it again. And again in 2022 and 2024.
**Midnight, June 30th.**
A little over a week from now — our FEC filing deadline of 2025 and our first since I announced that I was running for reelection.
I know my team and I have reached out about deadlines like this before, but it’s really important that we have a big show of momentum when our report is made public.
People are wondering if progressives are up to the task of standing against Trump, Republicans, and their far-right agenda, meaning if we fall short we’ll send all the wrong messages about the strength of this movement.
**$5.**
That's the amount I'm asking you to contribute right now to stand with our movement, close our fundraising gap, and get the job done.
Are you in?

I'll never forget it — that was the day we launched our first campaign for Congress. The truth is, I had no idea what to expect. But because of supporters like you, that was never in doubt. I’m excited to share that I’ve received the endorsement of Defend the Vote, a key advocacy organization that fights to preserve our most valuable American rights: the freedom to vote and to make our voices heard. They are leading the way to protect and expand access to the ballot so that voters can make their voices heard and election workers can safely run free and fair elections. I’m proud to be their partner on critical legislation like the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Act.
[https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfvK4UpmTmVp0EVWXBoQLFaJuSGwTUqLLlc1sDb7k0Zqc9Ds91kf9l0oIcBAESNWCiZw9mI0Cp2g83QhruSMlWMoVJtlQ38K8naEPJS_OZusp-I0YRrzvBxDZXkVPYNhom_yFhiHQ?key=iXVotb0EJb5SNTFfduaUIg]
In 2024, one-third of the American people voted for President Trump, one-third voted for someone else, and one-third did not feel passionately enough, heard, or represented to even vote. Looking forward to 2026, it is critical that we engage the one-third of the American electorate who did not feel compelled to vote in the last election – that means making sure everyone has the opportunity to cast their vote. I'm proud to partner with Defend the Vote, because I understand that the first step toward rebuilding faith in American government is ensuring that everyone knows their voice is being heard.
We need to elect a pro-democracy majority in 2026. Will you stand with me? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/blu-sefc-q2-2025-em?refcode=blu_em_sefc_2025-06-26]

Hi friend,
If there were ever a political moment to fight for our fundamental freedoms, it is now.
My career in public service has been guided by the belief that all Americans are entitled to four fundamental freedoms:
🚀 The freedom to rise. We should build an economy that values workers and working families, ending childhood poverty, and making our state affordable for everyone, not just those at the top.
📖 The freedom to learn. We must reimagine our education system to inspire and empower our children and give our educators the respect, support and pay they deserve.
💛 The freedom from violence. We must keep every Coloradan safe in their homes, schools, places of worship and on our streets, while fighting the extremism that flourishes online.
🗳️ The freedom to govern ourselves. We should eradicate dark money from our politics—putting power back in the hands of the people—by protecting our voting rights and reforming our electoral system.
Fighting for these freedoms has never been more important—and whether it's in the U.S. Senate or as your next Governor, I'll never stop fighting for them.
I’m running for governor because I know that Colorado can lay a roadmap for the rest of the country. From protecting our most basic freedoms to dreaming big for a better future, that work starts here, now, together.
If you’re with me, consider donating to my campaign before our critical end-of-quarter deadline on Monday, June 30th. >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_mfb_email-25q2-g?refcode=X_250626_fourfreedoms_eoq4_act]

clean_body: [] Hi friend, If there were ever a political moment to fight for our fundamental freedoms, it is now. My career in public service has been guided by the belief that all Americans are entitled to four fundamental freedoms: 🚀 The freedom to rise. We should build an economy that values workers and working families, ending childhood poverty, and making our state affordable for everyone, not just those at the top. 📖 The freedom to learn. We must reimagine our education system to inspire and empower our children and give our educators the respect, support and pay they deserve. 💛 The freedom from violence. We must keep every Coloradan safe in their homes, schools, places of worship and on our streets, while fighting the extremism that flourishes online. 🗳️ The freedom to govern ourselves. We should eradicate dark money from our politics—putting power back in the hands of the people—by protecting our voting rights and reforming our electoral system. Fighting for these freedoms has never been more important—and whether it's in the U.S. Senate or as your next Governor, I'll never stop fighting for them. I’m running for governor because I know that Colorado can lay a roadmap for the rest of the country. ---
**Peter — the GOP is trying to sell our children’s futures down the river to line their own pockets.** Under Donald Trump’s “Big, Beautiful Bill” that would give tax cuts to the wealthiest people in the country, public education is on the chopping block. Their bill would create the first-ever national school voucher program — a move that would divert billions of dollars away from public schools and hand it to wealthy families and private schools. We’ve seen this story time and time again. States create their own voucher programs, which end up taking crucial resources away from public schools. The GOP’s plan would only make that problem worse by ripping even _more_ funds away from public schools. School vouchers undermine public education and hurt our students, especially those in rural communities. On Tuesday, I held a forum with teachers, parents, and education leaders to discuss why we cannot let this destructive bill pass. body:
I wanted to invite you to our first-ever Down Ballot Defenders Summit so that you could hear directly from four incredible state legislators about their powerful and transformational work. | | |
---
| |
---|---
Our state legislators go to work every day to fight for Americans across the country – fighting to lower health care and grocery costs, protect and expand voting rights, and fund public education for our children. **This work isn’t easy, and it takes an entire team to elect the leaders we deserve in our nation’s legislatures.** That’s why I wanted to invite you to our first-ever Down Ballot Defenders Summit so that you could hear directly from four incredible state legislators about their powerful and transformational work. name: Rachel Rothman, Campaign Manager
subject: I won't lie
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_gen-election-launch_em_q22025? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_gen-election-launch_em_q22025?]
Folks,
I am proud to have earned the Democratic nomination for Virginia Attorney General. As soon as I heard the results, I thought of my family legacy.
When my grandfather, Hilary H. Jones Sr., wanted to become an attorney, he couldn’t go to law school in Virginia because schools wouldn’t admit Black people. He had to borrow bar exam practice books from other students because law libraries refused to loan them to him, but he never gave up. He became a pioneering civil rights attorney.
My father, Jerrauld, had to pass a special test for Black students to attend his public elementary school. He had slurs and rocks thrown at him, but he never gave up, either. He graduated from law school and served Virginia in all three branches of government.
When I look at my childhood photos, I understand why they never gave up – even when the odds were against them: they weren’t just fighting for themselves. They were fighting so that I – and every child across Virginia – wouldn’t have to face the discrimination they did.
Like my family, I am dedicated to facing injustice head-on – and that is what’s driving my campaign for Attorney General.
Before I go on, will you become a Founding Donor of my General Election campaign by chipping in just $5 right now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_gen-election-launch_em_q22025?amount=5]
DONATE $5 NOW → [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_gen-election-launch_em_q22025?amount=5]
DONATE ANOTHER AMOUNT NOW → [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_gen-election-launch_em_q22025?]
Even today, Virginia’s legal system contains holdovers from Jim Crow laws. Voting rights are under attack. And every day, I see ways in which those in power are threatening the freedoms that my family – and so many others – fought to protect.
As Attorney General, I will stand up against any threat to our rights so my sons – and all children across the Commonwealth – can have a better life.
Folks, this is the most important moment of this campaign so far – and I need your help to launch my General Election campaign. Can you please support my campaign with a gift of $5 – or anything you can spare – today? Your donation will make a huge impact on my ability to win my tough race in November. I’m proud to say we flipped the Senate RED, thanks in part to this win in Montana. Winning this race wasn’t a “gimme.” We had to claw, scratch, and fight for every single vote. That’s because Tester had a WAR CHEST of $25,000,000. He threw money at anybody and everybody who’d smear my good name. It was truly one of the hardest battles of my life. Despite all the obstacles , I was able to keep fighting to the end because of one man : Senator Steve Daines , now my fellow Republican Senator from Montana. As Chairman of the National Republican Senatorial Committee (NRSC), he not only gave me the ammunition we needed to win this fight, but he was also instrumental in flipping four Senate seats, giving Republicans the Senate Majority. Steve is up for re-election in 2026. Chuck Schumer and every Democrat in the nation would love nothing more than to see Steve Daines – the Republican Senate Majority Maker! – booted from Congress. 2026 is right around the corner. Steve’s radical opponent has already told the media that every minute since 2024, she’s been building a plan to win in 2026. That means Democrats are already funneling money and resources into this race. The fight to keep this Senate seat in Republican hands will be another knock-down, drag-out fight. For America's Future, Senator Tim Sheehy (R-MT) Former Navy SEAL Purple Heart Recipient P.S. We all have Steve to thank for booting Chuck Schumer out of the Majority Leader’s chair! The radicals in the Democrat party are FUMING. They’d love nothing more than to send Steve packing for his role in producing the 2024 Republican Trifecta. Senator Steve Daines ** | | Paid for by Steve Daines for Montana

This win wasn’t just his — it was a win for all of us. A clear, undeniable sign of what’s possible when we build a multiracial, multigenerational coalition of people, grounded in the struggles of the marginalized, and united by a shared vision of justice and liberation for all. We’ll connect with members from across the country and spend time digging into WFP's powerbuilding strategy. Then, we'll hear from leaders on the frontlines of this wave sweeping the nation — including leaders from the New York Working Families Party , Seattle City Councilmember Mercedes Rinck , and others organizing for policies that disrupt the status quo, bring down the cost of living, and put working-class communities first. Zohran’s primary victory in New York this week shows what happens when we lead with courage — not compromise. It’s a reminder that when candidates speak directly to the material needs of working people, and build campaigns rooted in community, people show up. And now it’s on us to build on that momentum. body:

Dear Friend of Liberty,

It's time for merit to make a comeback.

[That’s why I’m writing to ask you to participate in Hillsdale College’s **DEFEAT DEI SURVEY**](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/s/c/vygS1geOdyHB8_y_jROS8jg9pUH81BzujiadWrgeMqisFngh9Xat1x6ZcDihkAYf4AU9N4PbNM2NU_DLxq0nFWvkI7el2GQz5wjMd-097_mM7rudXOjy5WyhH58S16FD4D6lwt1cNeIzNrFFM1DCZb71aeoqi1-cqf1R75CGDCPVmtQFq6qiCir-LWA4E_6mJ_9dUKhK5zvg8vY4TzRYFjJZQzvwsLCZdJ9G60P6PRTEGaisbofq19J36SnCgMP7EAedH_fQ5FtJl5Torx1IcnAgl7jwnNWx5UKhoROzduu8zf_sogRw7WKI4NLuCPfDAds-ocDYDEGaSb3D4mQ7szSGmxQjfu0pWc65jLnSlQnUNn3pL0B57MKQNum-W5PTei-rnQAcQlTT3woGwN65WlJLCRdASInf-Cp4ekNuqbEy5K6ORz-8uK1RwxzzwzTxmqoophQ25ZVb3oo1DS8seW8OibjpxTJSsTZ3BKVP_mn7tLH7GvTo-gi_RrtX9m3tdQ9Y_EnCjPEyfRNKC3loMfPfoFW9yXXJIOiVYDZ3unCdAMqOEj-htsowYFvSU3MTLa5GKlz3GpXZ5q9ZqH1kON041yc-UjGmZcOF4lzpx0ZQYL6CT7wVgB_IALsI7s5B-a36LZqEwBkwStaMGsHyawKG4WrJbELfuU-ojxI4f6L0R1ajlKbthk0xcaNoLVP9QEcxMVwEMg/PeiPeZOllpML9pRDBc9eTkSPq5Le8xqH/10).

Like many Americans, I'm sure you're all too aware of the damage that has been done to our country by policies implemented in the name of "Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion" or "DEI."

Race grifters and hustlers make _millions_ perpetuating DEI lies, including...

* America is a nation built on slavery, not freedom.
* All racial disparities are indisputable evidence of systemic racism--and if you question this conclusion, you must be a racist.
* Students in K-12 schools can be divided into oppressors and oppressed based on their skin color.

DEI policies have infected almost every aspect of American life, from K-12 schools to college admissions and job applications. They have even spread into the hard sciences and the military.

These policies endanger lives and, ultimately, Western Civilization itself.

I'm sure, like a lot of Americans, you want to know what you can do to stop DEI. One of the most fundamental steps is ...

**Countering the far-Left ideologies that are being taught to students in K-12 schools, colleges, and universities.**

Hillsdale College, where I am president, is engaged in a nationwide fight on the battlefield of education to save young Americans from this anti-American agenda.

Since our founding in 1844, we have offered "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty."

To do this work well, we need a clear understanding of **what informed Americans like you think about DEI and how best to fight it.**

So please share your views by completing the **DEFEAT DEI SURVEY** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time.

Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept any government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations.

**We remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities have rejected their founding statements and embraced radical and dangerous ideologies.**

Please join Hillsdale College in our defense of Western Civilization by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **DEFEAT DEI SURVEY** , which you can access at this secure link:

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/defeat-dei-survey**](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/s/c/hVmEc34zGC4TI-VMxwd9jJL12URH7M_4Id7dkSXt5O8CG69phD0lqRKn4TuCUOxk7dZcMMDzvROmKz0zWsoqzDYAoEIu_1Fsmv761ITAMvnfJquw3dRRKT2p2TL48G8nd6LQBiyNWCvHK5MT26SdKUxiX-yKKvpl5iI3B7gvqq0sTo0-q7bN2-X--SEq-6DgQhQXewixSXQjbFVPgM_4ctHWUCrQnKQs_SZqyFFICJZ9DR7tkRkEHkG-GrvnSFpCW2URTLCPx4UT8LezDQQc7Qoc3FIGe6x2rOW6oxDdVtALUjfxAyCXPesiD0SwKp0VmHZCzPNGUxdIJ93Iih5DSnPLjlGbWFldan0MHI__ABQrUu-fQaOIS7lfHN8z7oae9TzHCGjBAU0K2xjrFyboI4RfF0e9FHYFWyVuZTKWpwkvqIvDymgfXLpcCLVcakM2WPKtJAas_wwfWgN_MjM0dLb3mt8jIJrqy7FgKKSnN42aCyojHDUELBIJTwdiW14f32iq_QEvwk10skALYfKzZwZ1Yt7M3EN_xpGHhTWf_fgQLqH9T8YAVyOg_02r-iSV1zD5iVZLRrId-HYQYZCVjdcS5Atn5993M6sS5o_hxL6rOxNKaxVDy1BEqoPKYcXmqpIjcGBSjbh6n7QoVOvqbVRdPAHlVdSABLZC_B0tHsQXT5C1ouuGMtlHo6cikZ2k_rppNWpKsw/QW5mQgHeTojJILm1akYeZ5y_lziJSb-E/10)

Larry P. Arnn

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
subject: Everyone counted us out
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
7 years ago today, Alexandria made history.
She had left her bartending job to challenge a 20 year incumbent Democrat for Congress — in line to become Speaker of the House — who was now outspending her 10-to-1.
Attack ads called her ‘extreme’ because she believed that everyday people could come together and defeat powerful special interests, win real action on the climate crisis, and build a democracy that works for all of us.
**Everyone counted her out**. But on June 26, 2018, Alexandria won the primary, putting her on the path to become the youngest woman ever elected to Congress.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250626-video.lnVY0i&refcode=em20250626-9179-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9179%2E2526796%2EaskD9l)
7 years later, Alexandria is still fighting for what she believes is common sense:
– That in the wealthiest nation in the history of the world, a person shouldn’t go bankrupt when they get sick.
– That a minimum wage should cover the minimum cost to live.
– That our elected officials should take on abuses of corporate greed everywhere they find it.
And together, we’ve built a movement fighting for real progressive change, from Medicare for All to democratizing fundraising power in politics.
[Will you make a $5 contribution today to keep our movement going strong? Alexandria doesn’t attend fancy cocktail fundraisers, or curry favor with billionaires — her fight is entirely powered by everyday people who believe a better world is possible.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250626-video.lnVY0i&refcode=em20250626-9179-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=9179%2E2526796%2EaskD9l)

Whether or not you can contribute, thank you for standing with this movement.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

But on June 26, 2018, Alexandria won the primary, putting her on the path to become the youngest woman ever elected to Congress. 7 years later, Alexandria is still fighting for what she believes is common sense: – That in the wealthiest nation in the history of the world, a person shouldn’t go bankrupt when they get sick. – That a minimum wage should cover the minimum cost to live. – That our elected officials should take on abuses of corporate greed everywhere they find it. And together, we’ve built a movement fighting for real progressive change, from Medicare for All to democratizing fundraising power in politics. Whether or not you can contribute, thank you for standing with this movement. In solidarity, Team AOC | ---|--- | | ---|---|--- Email us: mailto: speak@ocasiocortez.com

Marrying John was one of the happiest days of my life, second only to the day marriage equality became legal for our entire country. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110315007/553949091/311254001?refcode=em-6.26.25-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTkxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNjhlMGQxZi1jODUyLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=q2SOtDok3diLLuHKr8UpUCqeaeG00B6_91afh6msVyk=) Ten years ago today, I was sitting in the Supreme Court fighting for my husband, John, and for queer couples like us across the nation. [Before sharing our story, I ask that you chip in to Equality Ohio and DASS to help protect our freedoms.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110315009/553949093/311254001?refcode=em-6.26.25-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTkxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNjhlMGQxZi1jODUyLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=q2SOtDok3diLLuHKr8UpUCqeaeG00B6_91afh6msVyk=) After ALS stole almost all of his physical abilities, I became John’s caretaker. After all, that’s what you do when you love someone. We began at-home hospice care out of concern over how John would be treated as an out gay man in a hospice facility. Even if we had been married, would they recognize me as his spouse in a healthcare setting? We had wanted to get married since the mid-1990s, but it became especially important to us as he neared the end of his life. Because marriage equality was not legal in Ohio, we flew to Maryland within two weeks of the Windsor decision striking down the federal Defense of Marriage Act. The day I took John’s hand in mine and we got married on the tarmac of a Maryland airport, was the happiest day of our life together. When we discovered the State of Ohio would refuse to list John as married or recognize me as John’s surviving spouse on his death certificate at the time he died, we started the fight that eventually became the Supreme Court case Obergefell v. Hodges. Although John died before our historic win, seeing how marriage equality has changed so many lives reminds me of him daily. **Sadly, the right to marriage we fought for is under attack, again.** Ten years later, anti-equality forces are attacking our rights like never before. In fact, they’re passing state laws and resolutions, trying to get the Supreme Court to overturn marriage equality. [Please split a donation between Equality Ohio and DASS to make sure we can keep fighting back.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110315010/553949094/311254001?refcode=em-6.26.25-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTkxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNjhlMGQxZi1jODUyLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=q2SOtDok3diLLuHKr8UpUCqeaeG00B6_91afh6msVyk=) __If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: __ | | | **[Chip in $10 Now](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110315011/553949097/311254001?refcode=em-6.26.25-all-a&express_lane=true&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTkxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNjhlMGQxZi1jODUyLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=q2SOtDok3diLLuHKr8UpUCqeaeG00B6_91afh6msVyk=)**

****
**You don’t have to take it from me. Just this year, the Idaho House passed a resolution urging the U.S. Supreme Court to reconsider the Obergefell decision.** Just a few months ago, the North Dakota House passed a similar bill. Supreme Court justices have also made it clear they want to overturn Obergefell and other decisions.
Even worse are the attacks on the transgender community, including in my home of Ohio, where transgender youth are subject to laws that have torn their healthcare away, removed their right to play sports or use the correct restroom at school and subjected them to a forced outing law, even when doing so puts them at risk of abuse at home.
I was lucky to love John, and our willingness to fight for each other – and our relationship – helped make the world a better place. I couldn’t have done it without more than thirty other plaintiffs and the attorneys who were part of Obergefell v. Hodges. It was a group effort, and that’s why we need your help today.
[Will you split a donation between Equality Ohio and DASS to stand with me and defend LGBTQ+ Equality?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110315017/553949112/311254001?refcode=em-6.26.25-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTkxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNjhlMGQxZi1jODUyLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=q2SOtDok3diLLuHKr8UpUCqeaeG00B6_91afh6msVyk=)
We won because our community refused anything less than equality. We refused to live in a world where birth and death certificates could ignore our lawful marriages. We refused to live in a world where we were unable to say “I do” to the person we love.
Today, we refuse to live in a world where birth certificates are weaponized to deny our gender identity. We refuse to live in a world where a loving parent cannot make healthcare decisions for their child. It’s time for us to demand equality and justice again.
We know what life was like before, and we are NOT going back.
This time, I hope you’ll join me and commit to protecting our right to not only love, but to exist.
Love first, and always,
Jim

_**ICE vs. We the People**_
**Jack Herrera on CHNV Parole Rollback & Trump's Deportation Obsession**

The Latino Vote Podcast Season 2025 Episode 19
| Chuck Rocha welcomes acclaimed reporter, **Jack Herrera (Texas Monthly, Political Magazine)** for an in-depth conversation about **the state of immigration enforcement under the Trump administration**. Jack shares how he went from covering the 2018 migrant caravans in Tijuana to exposing **the end of the CHNV parole program** —half a million Cubans, Haitians, Nicaraguans and Venezuelans who did everything **“the right way”** now rendered deportable overnight.

They also cover the alarming rise in U.S. citizens, including Congressional candidates and everyday families, **being detained by ICE—even without warrants.**
---
|
---
| | | |
**Today's Headlines:**

Bernie and I may come from different states, but whether you’re from Vermont, the Rust Belt, or anywhere across the country, it’s clear: _corporate power is out of control._

You can see it when you drive through Pennsylvania—the endless, reckless pursuit of corporate profit has destroyed towns across our commonwealth, hurt working families, and ripped away the American Dream.

The American dream has been stolen from us by out of control corporate power and the corrupt politicians who embolden it—guys like Donald Trump and Elon Musk.

_**So Bernie and I are calling BS.**_

Your prescription drugs aren’t costing you an arm and a leg because of “woke” culture. The “libs” didn’t hollow out factory towns in Pennsylvania. And no, your grocery bill didn’t double because a trans kid wants to live with dignity.

It’s because out-of-control corporate power means higher costs! It was Wall Street, corporate lobbyists, and bought-off politicians who shipped jobs overseas, busted unions, and let PBMs and insurance companies write the rules. Meanwhile, Donald Trump uses every distraction he can find—blaming immigrants, teachers, Canadians—to keep you from seeing the real enemy: oligarchs robbing this country blind.

_It doesn’t have to be like this, Derek._

**I am a veteran and union organizer, so trust me when I say that I’ve seen the power of solidarity firsthand. That’s why I know, if we stand together, we can show them that we have power money can’t buy.**

When these corporations rip us off, when monopolies hurt small businesses, and when the American Dream is stolen from us— _we HAVE to stand together and we HAVE to fight back._

We have to organize, we have to get LOUD, and we have to take action if we’re going to face down this corruption head-on.

Bernie and I are fighting with a fire for hardworking people. We want to build an economy for everyone, get money out of politics, stand up for workers and unions, and ensure the government works _for the people._

**We know what side we’re on, and we need you with us in this critical fight, Derek.**

| | | Friend - We can't afford to lose your support!

**I 've come to truly appreciate your support. I know everything you've given to get us to where we are today. **

But you know just as well as I do how quickly things can change.

I wanted to inform you sooner rather than later that, as of today, your **House GOP Membership**** ** has YET to be renewed.

June 26, 2025 **EMILYs List Statement on U.S. Supreme Court Allowing States to Block Medicaid Patients from Accessing Care At Planned Parenthood** WASHINGTON, D.C. — Today, the U.S. Supreme Court delivered a decision in _Medina v. Planned Parenthood South Atlantic_ , allowing the state of South Carolina to block Medicaid funding from Planned Parenthood because it provides abortions. This decision means South Carolinians enrolled in Medicaid may no longer be able to use their coverage at Planned Parenthood for birth control, cancer screenings, STI testing and treatment, and other preventive health care. It opens the door to other Republican-led states to follow suit and threatens access to sexual and reproductive care for up to 70 million people with Medicaid coverage across the country.

It's Raul. With the end-of-quarter deadline just days away, I want to take a moment to speak directly to you — because what’s happening in CA-25 right now matters deeply for the future of our state and our country. Republicans see this seat as flippable, and they’re already spending big to attack me. They think they can buy their way back into power, but I know Californians are fired up and ready to keep CA-25 blue. Let’s be clear: if they succeed here, the consequences will be devastating — not just for this district, but for California as a whole. We’ve already seen the damage Republicans are willing to inflict. Donald Trump is back and already wreaking havoc, from threatening to withhold disaster aid, to attacking how we manage our land and water and using fear and force to try to silence Californians. And this is only the beginning. Now, with the House up for grabs, Republicans see an opportunity to flip this seat and give Trump the unchecked power he’s already reaching for. I won’t let that happen. But we can’t take anything for granted — not with this much dark money flooding into the race. We need to stand together and hit our $11,000 end-of-quarter fundraising goal. That’s how we show we’re not going anywhere and that this district, and this state, won’t be pushed around. clean_body: The MAGA Supreme Court just ruled that South Carolina can bar Planned Parenthood from Medicaid, and patients can’t do a damn thing about it. | | Peter, Three years ago this week, the Court overturned Roe v. Wade. Now, they’re starting the work of dismantling Planned Parenthood: Cancer screenings? STI care? Birth control? All of these are routine healthcare services that Planned Parenthood clinics provide. But the MAGA Supreme Court just ruled that South Carolina can rip this crucial care away from thousands of Medicaid patients just because Republicans have declared Planned Parenthood a boogeyman. Extremist, anti-choice propagandists across the country are celebrating. Indeed, the MAGA Supreme Court just notched another win for those who want to roll back civil rights and strip us of our right to healthcare. Millions of Medicaid patients across the country rely on Planned Parenthood for life-saving care. Many are low-income and marginalized individuals. But now that the Court has given states a green light to defund Planned Parenthood, it puts healthcare even further out of reach. As if it wasn’t bad enough that this ruling strips thousands of low-income patients of their healthcare, the decision goes further in taking away our ability to fight for our rights. The decision throws up huge roadblocks for affected patients and undermines their right to sue to preserve their healthcare. Ultimately, the Court’s decision will make it much harder for marginalized people to litigate individual rights in court, leaving the rest of us at the mercy of the powerful. In her dissent, Justice Jackson wrote that with this ruling “the project of stymying one of the country’s great civil rights laws continues.” MAGA extremists believe healthcare is a privilege, not a right. And their bought-and-paid-for Supreme Court is helping them make that nightmare a reality. It’s up to us to take our democracy back. We can’t let cases like this one be met with silence. subject: They won’t let up
body:
| | Peter – The far-right is so desperate to take back this seat and kick me out of Congress that they’ll say, do, and spend whatever it takes.

**Get this: The NRCC just launched another huge ad blitz smearing me, spreading misleading claims, and trying to distort my record.**

If these extremists are spending this much to defeat me this early in the race – we could be in trouble. This is already shaping up to be another expensive, highly competitive re-election fight, and we still have a long road ahead.

We have to stop them.

Congresswoman Melanie Stansbury brought props to a committee hearing... and they completely backfired.

She proudly held up a sign meant to support her argument—but the numbers didn’t even add up to 100%. Republicans pounced. But instead of laughing it off, Stansbury doubled down and threw a fit.

Mark breaks it all down—and argues that **New Mexico deserves better than this kind of unserious behavior** from its elected officials.

Deb Haaland’s new campaign video for Governor is raising eyebrows—and Krysty explains why it could backfire. Sam Bregman will still get smoked by Haaland in the primary but Harland’s struggles could make the race more exciting. We break down how the messaging missteps are already starting to show.

Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth**[](https://substack.com/redirect/ca900d47-590d-4f91-a051-9db7f15ff107?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)[sounded off on reporters this morning,](https://substack.com/redirect/43cfb101-c84f-4857-8bf9-63ae7c09dc3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** including his former colleague Fox News' Jennifer Griffin, for biased reporting of Trump's military strikes on Iran's nuclear program.
This was personal...
[Click To Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/43cfb101-c84f-4857-8bf9-63ae7c09dc3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/43cfb101-c84f-4857-8bf9-63ae7c09dc3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"Are you certain none of the highly enriched uranium was moved?" Griffin asked Hegseth.
"Of course we are watching every single aspect, but **[Jennifer, you've been about the worst,](https://substack.com/redirect/43cfb101-c84f-4857-8bf9-63ae7c09dc3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** the one who misrepresents the most intentionally what the president says," Hegseth told the reporter bluntly.
Griffin didn't accept his charge against her, firing back, "In fact, I was the first to describe the B-2 bombers, the refueling, the entire mission with great accuracy! So I take issue with that!"
During the press conference, **[Hegseth accused reporters for wanting the Iran strikes to fail.](https://substack.com/redirect/43cfb101-c84f-4857-8bf9-63ae7c09dc3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** "You, the press, specifically you, the press corps, because you cheer against Trump so hard," he said. "It's like in your DNA and in your blood to cheer against Trump because you want him not to be successful so bad."
Trump backed Hegseth **[in a Truth Social post](https://substack.com/redirect/52dc786c-973b-4cce-90dd-ee141aa00984?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Thursday morning before Hegseth spoke, suggesting CNN and the New York Times "will be firing the reporters who made up the FAKE stories on the Iran Nuclear sites because they got it so wrong."

# Pentagon established 250 mile military buffer zone at southern border
The Pentagon announced on Wednesday the creation of a **[new military buffer zone in Texas](https://substack.com/redirect/ccc4ec08-40b9-42ee-901a-2315f0692577?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in an effort to empower active‐duty troops to temporarily detain migrants amid a historic plunge in illegal border crossings.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ccc4ec08-40b9-42ee-901a-2315f0692577?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Pentagon establishes new defense zones:** The Department of Defense has announced the creation of two additional National Defense Areas (NDAs) along the U.S.-Mexico border--one spanning approximately 250 miles of the Rio Grande River in Texas under Joint Base San Antonio and another near Marine Corps Air Station Yuma in Arizona.
* **Troops gain detention authority:** The new zones grant active-duty military personnel the power to detect, monitor and temporarily detain migrants and trespassers--classifying unauthorized entry as misdemeanor trespassing punishable by up to 18 months in prison.
* **Record-low border crossings cited:** Officials attribute a sharp decline in illegal border crossings to the expanded military buffer zones, stricter asylum policies than the Biden administration and enhanced enforcement cooperation with Mexico.
* **Continuous success for ICE:** In June so far, there have been a reported 5,414 border apprehensions and 986 escapees, which are both respectfully the lowest ever reported.

* * *
# Wesley Hunt demands 1.4 million illegal migrants removed from government healthcare
Rep. Wesley Hunt sent letters to DHS Secretary Kristi Noem and CMS Administrator Dr. Mehmet Oz proposing a task force **[to "swiftly" remove roughly 1.4 million illegal immigrants](https://substack.com/redirect/7532aca9-dca2-4ff8-a966-b9fb0fbbd519?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** currently receiving Medicaid benefits, calling it an "unsustainable burden on the American taxpayer" while Democrats ignore this "staggering truth."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7532aca9-dca2-4ff8-a966-b9fb0fbbd519?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Task Force Request:** Hunt formally requested the Department of Homeland Security establish a task force to "identify those unlawfully exploiting our healthcare system and ensure they are swiftly removed from our country," targeting illegal migrants who don't meet citizenship and immigration status requirements for Medicaid enrollment but are covered under current state-funded programs.
* **Legislative Battle:** The proposal comes as Trump's "One Big Beautiful Bill" faces challenges in the Senate, with the Senate Parliamentarian striking language that would exclude illegal immigrants from Medicaid eligibility. However, sources say those portions are being actively re-drafted to ensure inclusion in the final bill, while a Congressional Budget Office document confirms about 1.4 million people don't meet legal requirements but receive coverage.

* * *
# Gay journalist blasts modern LGBTQ movement as "radical ideology"
Gay journalist and author Andrew Sullivan said the **[LGBTQ movement is far too radical](https://substack.com/redirect/c5da13bd-9c24-4d8a-a4c9-fdc84f34961f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in a New York Times guest essay.
* **Radical Shift in LGBTQ movement:** Sullivan argued that the LGBTQ movement has shifted from a civil rights success to a "madness" driven by radical activism.
* **Critique of current focus:** Sullivan criticizes the movement's focus on issues like transgender rights and drag queen story hours, suggesting they distract from the original goals of LGBTQ equality.
_"I didn 't and don't believe that being a man or a woman has nothing to do with biology," Sullivan wrote. "My sexual orientation is based on a biological distinction between men and women: I'm attracted to the former and not to the latter. And now I was supposed to believe the difference didn't exist?"_
* **Concerns over public backlash:** The writer also expressed concern that the movement's current trajectory alienates moderate supporters and risks backlash from the broader public, especially with the heightened focus on children's sexual orientation, specifically with the recent Supreme Court ruling to uphold Tennessee's ban of gender sex change surgeries for children.
* **Call for unity and pragmatism:** Sullivan called for a return to a more inclusive and pragmatic approach to LGBTQ advocacy, emphasizing the importance of unity and shared values.

body:

Team, I was recently honored to receive the New Jersey AFL-CIO’s Legislative Award at their annual Labor Awards Dinner.

[RIPPED HEADLINE GRAPHIC] [https://www.tapinto.net/towns/paterson/sections/government/articles/rep-nellie-pou-honored-with-afl-cio-legislative-award-for-championing-workers-rights]

I told the crowd of labor leaders from across New Jersey and the country what I’ll tell you now: you can always count on me to fight for the right to organize, to stand up for worker rights, and to show up for the working men and women who power our economy.

But now I’m facing one of the most competitive re-election fights in the country. My district, which was once a reliably blue seat, was narrowly carried by Donald Trump in 2024. Now, national Republicans are targeting me.

Our district can be the one that decides if we take back the House next fall.

If you’re able to, can you chip in $20 today to help us protect this battleground seat and keep a champion for working families in Congress? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/pou_em?refcode=250626_np_afl_l2]

Democrats got our asses handed to us in 2024. And it's not as simple as a bad economy or messaging fails--we forgot a lesson we should have tattooed on our foreheads: politics is the game of addition, not subtraction.
We've got to do everything in our power to get as many voters as possible to believe the Democratic Party is the party that's gonna fight for them. And in a country as ideologically messy as this one, that means our coalition is gonna be messy too. That's the cost of getting shit done in a democracy.
No purity tests.
_I 'm committed to keeping Endless Urgency free for everyone--but I rely on paid subscribers (starting at just $8/month) to keep it going. If you find value in the work, consider becoming a paid subscriber._
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..UO_5t6MX1liMqew3ZIdUOwOqH3zC7DYDx0X8_shvdfY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=166918539)
Right now, the coalition that's going to stop the worst of what Trump is unleashing on this country--the coalition that can win the midterms in 2026, the coalition that can actually take the White House back and put it in the hands of someone who isn't a raging lunatic--stretches from Zohran Mamdani, who just won the primary to become the Democratic nominee for mayor of New York City, to Joe Walsh, the ex-Republican congressman who tried to primary Trump in 2020 and just switched parties last month.
Zohran can help us expand our coalition to include people left out and disillusioned by the system, especially younger voters getting killed in this economy who are hungry for something new. Joe can help us speak to many Republicans and moderate voters who haven't quite turned on Trump or embraced the Democratic Party yet but still care about our democracy and our fundamental rights.
I want to stand shoulder to shoulder with people who are in this fight for the right reasons. I'm good with being in a room that includes Zohran and includes Joe, even if I've got deep disagreements with both of them on many issues--because we're all rowing in the same damn direction. I want to fight these fascists with people who care. And I want to fight _with_ people _for_ something better. People who give a shit about democracy, who want to make life better for folks, who believe in building community--not slicing it up.
We need an ideologically diverse group of fighters. Right now, we've got too many people answering to corrupt billionaires and corporate donors--or who are just plain cowards and bad communicators. And too many of my fellow Democrats still think you can carve your way to a majority--shave off this group, leave out that one. But that's fantasy politics. That's not how this system works. Not if you want the White House. Not if you want enough seats in the Senate to do something big like pass Medicare for All or restore Roe v. Wade protections. Not if you want the House to pass more than just symbolic garbage.
And we need to go big. We need to be bold. We need to give people something to believe in again. Not just believe in--see and feel in their actual, everyday lives. Because 80% of Americans are struggling right now. And when people are desperate, they take risks.
You saw that risk in New York City. People rallied behind Zohran Mamdani--a DSA member, a proud socialist--not simple because of ideology, but because he showed up for them. He fought against the establishment and won. And he took down Andrew Cuomo--a man whose moral rot is matched only by his ego.
As NYC Comptroller Brad Lander, who I'd argue helped tip the scales for Zohran with his endorsement, said on CNN last night: "The line in the Democratic Party right now is not between progressive and moderate. It's between fighters and folders."
I've been saying this for months: it's about who can throw a punch and who can't. And I know Zohran Mamdani can throw punches. Joe Walsh can throw hands, too. And they're throwing for the right damn reasons--because they care whether you can feed your kids, start a family, buy a home, retire with dignity, live a life with meaning. You know, the American Dream. The real one.
People want authenticity. They want fire. And they want to be called in. Not called out. They want someone who looks them in the eye and says, "Yeah, I see what you're going through--and I'm here to fight for you."
_I 'm committed to keeping Endless Urgency free for everyone--but I rely on paid subscribers (starting at just $8/month) to keep it going. If you find value in the work, consider becoming a paid subscriber._
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..UO_5t6MX1liMqew3ZIdUOwOqH3zC7DYDx0X8_shvdfY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=166918539)
I saw a quote the other day from some anonymous Democratic member of Congress whining that donors and activists get more excited about Zohran than about some centrist candidate. And I'm like--yeah, no shit. Because Zohran moves people. His policies are bold. His politics are loud. Whether you agree with every plank or not, people showed up for him because he didn't flinch and more so, because he included their struggles in his fight, genuinely.
And let me be clear: bold and interesting aren't exclusive to the far left. You can be a centrist with fire in your belly. You can be a moderate with fresh ideas. You can be left of center and still throw haymakers. The key is being real. Being willing to fight, together. Being someone who takes a risk and actually gives a damn about people.
The campaign that Zohran Mamdani ran in New York City to win this primary isn't going to work everywhere. That's why having an ideologically diverse coalition is so important. We need people who can win in New York City. We need people who can win in Michigan and Wisconsin. We need people who can win in South Carolina and Georgia. We're not going to get there through purity tests.
People are thirsty for a new kind of leadership--even if it's just perceived authenticity. And that's how you get Donald Trump. That's why he won. Because to tens of millions of Americans who feel like the system gave up on them, Trump looked real. I don't believe he is--but he played the part (and played Americans) well enough to win. The key difference, however, is that Trump does not walk the walk. He may have been unique in his rhetoric but he is not authentic or consistent in his actions.
I believe in Zohran Mamdani's sincerity way more than I ever could in Trump's. But he won for the same reason: he showed up. He spoke to the struggle. He made people believe someone was finally in their corner. And most importantly, he followed through on his word through his actions. Zohran has built a coalition of diverse voices in his campaign to fight with him and I believe he will continue to walk the talk if he is elected Mayor.
So no--I'm not going to play the stupid game of picking between Zohran Mamdani and Joe Walsh or anybody else in between. That's not the divide I give a shit about.
The line that matters is: are you ready to stand up against fascism? To give people a reason to care again? To build something bigger than yourself and more important than being endorsed by a Super PAC? To give people a little hope that government can work again, that government answers to the People and genuinely acts in their interest, that life can get better, that we're not doomed to suffer under Trump and these spineless Republican losers forever?
If we can do that--if we can build a coalition that's scrappy, loud, unafraid, willing to build bridges, and real--then we can take this damn country back. And more importantly, we can help people who are desperate for change.

Peter,

There have been a number of big updates in this race, so I wanted to take a moment to update you directly:
* **My hard-fought victory last year has made me a Republican target.** I was one of only a few Democrats to flip red seats, and the NRCC and super PACs have launched attacks to make me a one-term Congressman.

* **Because of this, national Democrats have named me to their “Frontline” list – a program for the most at-risk incumbents in 2026.** This district has also been named as one of the most competitive in the nation by the _Cook Political Report_ and _Inside Elections_.

* **Despite all the noise in this race and from the Trump Administration, I’m laser-focused on delivering results for CA-27.** I’ve introduced legislation, created a caucus to cut through gridlock, and am putting our communities first.

* **Our end-of-quarter deadline is in 4 days – when we’re required by the FEC to report our fundraising data.** With control of the House hinging on just three seats, we can’t afford to have a poor showing.

I'm running for Congress in a special election in Southern Arizona where early voting is already underway. And I'm honored to have the support of Jane Fonda Climate PAC — because we're in a fight for our future, and I'm not backing down. This campaign is about taking on the fossil fuel companies that have spent decades blocking climate action. I'm proud to be the only candidate in this race who's signed the No Fossil Fuel Money Pledge. I'm running a grassroots campaign that's funded by people, not polluters. **Right now, my campaign is racing against the clock toward our final FEC fundraising deadline before Election Day. I'm ready to take that same fight to Congress to pass the Green New Deal and the Environmental Justice for All Act — and to finally end the billions in tax giveaways to oil and gas companies.
Climate change is no longer a distant threat — it's here, and we're living through the consequences: wildfires, extreme heat, floods, and droughts that are displacing families and devastating communities across the country.
But we still have time to change course if we elect leaders who are willing to stand up to the fossil fuel industry and fight for our planet. That's why I'm running. Because it's going to take more than speeches and small steps. It's going to take bold action and political courage.
That's what this campaign is about — and I hope you'll be a part of it.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? ### Zohran Mamdani's primary election win has unleashed anti-Muslim hate--and we need to be ready to fight back with justice

| Jun 26

The ink has barely dried on Zohran Mamdani's historic victory as the Democratic nominee for Mayor of New York City--and already, the coordinated Islamophobia machine is kicking into overdrive. If you thought the post-9/11 era or the 2011 "Shariah law scare" were the peak of anti-Muslim hysteria in America, I regret to inform you: we're about to surpass it. **Let 's Address This.**
Quick Ask! I am doing everything in my power to stave off fascism in the United States, and I need your support. **Subscribe and join more than 135,000 fellow activists.**
[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack..0nI0zKP3hy9csPQglmkat44l1AAz4dmiKGThuKF03j0?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=166929347)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/41a16901-3d4b-4998-839f-89e8fb6c9b8f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Zohran Mamdani (Left) and Brad Lander (Center)
Donald Trump wasted no time unleashing a bigoted tirade against Mamdani--a U.S. citizen, an elected official, and now a front-running mayoral candidate. This is not new for Trump, a man whose entire political career is built on white grievance and manufactured Muslim threats. But what is especially insidious--and what corporate media refuses to acknowledge--is that every racist thing Trump has said about Mamdani has already been said by Democrats like Andrew Cuomo and billionaire Cuomo donor Whitney Tilson.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b5b1d8c2-7740-4e14-b52c-f417ab989ea3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Tilson's smear campaign against Mamdani was one of the most vile in recent memory. He peddled grotesque Islamophobic ads falsely accusing Mamdani of wanting to kill Jews--an outrageous and dangerous lie with echoes of 20th-century blood libel propaganda. And the _New York Times_ --with full knowledge of these attacks--endorsed Tilson anyway. What signal does that send to Muslim Americans across this country?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2dfb3f0f-cdf5-4be4-af37-ebbab77a947a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Let's be clear: Democrats will not defeat Trumpism by acting like Trump. You cannot denounce white supremacy at brunch and then endorse it at the ballot box. Islamophobia is not just a Republican problem--it is deeply embedded in bipartisan political strategy, media narratives, and donor influence. And it is used, always, to protect the status quo and vilify anyone who challenges concentrated wealth and power--especially if they are brown, Muslim, and unapologetically working-class.
Now that Mamdani has prevailed, the billionaires who bankrolled Cuomo's failed comeback have already pledged to spend even more to defeat him in the general. And right-wing outlets are following suit. Stephen Miller--the architect of Trump's Muslim Ban--shared a tweet suggesting Mamdani's mere election proves "the warning of failed immigration." Imagine saying this about the city that literally has the Statue of Liberty calling on the world to send us its immigrants.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4f721251-ee3e-4a75-b008-6fd9690d243c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Meanwhile, mega MAGA cultist Charlie Kirk spouts hate so deranged it borders on parody. He wants us to panic over one Muslim mayor while ignoring the fact that white Christian men have killed _8,842_ Americans in just the last year. Since 1865, over 5,000 Black Americans (conservatively) have been lynched and murdered by white supremacist groups like the KKK--groups that proudly self-identify as "Christian."
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..0nI0zKP3hy9csPQglmkat44l1AAz4dmiKGThuKF03j0?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=166929347)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1fd04a16-01ac-4e2e-b05b-011299a77942?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
By Charlie Kirk logic, should all white Christians be banned from politics? This isn't just stupidity. It's strategy. And for those who doubt that the KKK self-identifies as Christian, let the KKK disabuse you of that notion.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f7429c2f-ea26-4d5b-860d-3fe3758ec6dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a0b532af-815d-4105-914d-ec233d5c34d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Again, I share this not because I think anything the KKK does is Christ-like, but to point out the absurdity of maligning the masses due to the extremism of the few. If we can recognize that 150 years of white supremacist KKK terrorism does not represent white people, surely anyone with a functioning frontal cortex can recognize that 19 hijackers don't represent 1.6B Muslims.
Speaker Mike Johnson has now joined the chorus, describing Mamdani as "radical"--language lifted straight from the Bush-Cheney playbook used to justify illegal wars in Afghanistan and Iraq. That dehumanizing rhetoric isn't just about polling. It's about giving MAGA extremists permission to escalate from hate speech to hate crimes.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9f74058c-e515-4fdc-8818-98ff33bfe36a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I was 19 years old when 9/11 happened. I remember what it felt like to walk through airports and classrooms with eyes following me. I remember the spike in hate crimes. I remember how silence became complicity. But I didn't have the platform then that I do now. Today, I plan to use this platform to demand humanity, demand justice, and demand accountability of those who do wrong.
And I know I'm not alone. Zohran Mamdani's win is proof that the American people--Muslims, Jews, Christians, non-believers, everyone--are ready for bold, just leadership--not bought-and-paid-for puppets of billionaire interests. But the road ahead will be rough. The backlash will be real. And the lies will multiply.
So we fight back.
We stand in solidarity with Zohran.
We call out Islamophobia from _all_ sides, not just the GOP.
We recognize that the MAGA movement is no longer a political party--it's a white supremacist cult. And we act accordingly.
The time is now. I ask you to stand with me. Subscribe. Share this message. Speak out at your schools, workplaces, churches, synagogues, temples, and mosques. The only way hate wins is if we let it go unchallenged. The only way we win is if we keep showing up.
Let's get to work.

As we commemorate the 10-year anniversary of the Obergefell decision—the landmark ruling that legalized marriage equality—I find myself reflecting deeply on my own journey as a gay man. Growing up, I delayed coming out to my friends and community until adulthood, when I finally felt safe to do so. The Obergefell ruling was not just a pivotal moment in my life; it was a monumental victory for countless individuals who dared to dream of loving freely and openly, without fear or shame.
However, in the wake of Trump’s election, our hard-won LGBTQ+ rights are facing unprecedented threats. We see book bans, restrictions preventing trans youth from participating in school sports, and alarming suggestions that the Supreme Court may even reverse the Obergefell decision.
Amidst these challenges, local leaders and school board members have become our frontline defenders, courageously resisting these cruel, unjust, and un-American actions. Their commitment reminds us of the vital role local activism plays in safeguarding our civil liberties.
_At Local Democracy Project, we are passionately dedicated to empowering progressive leaders who recognize that protecting our rights begins at the grassroots level. We can’t afford to take our progress for granted; it demands our vigilance and relentless action._
**As we honor this significant milestone in marriage equality, I invite you to join us in this critical mission. Your support is essential in ensuring that our rights and democracy are shielded from those who seek to undermine them.**

clean_body: I need you to sign your NumbersUSA “Deport 1 Million” petition right away.| | | | | | | | My Fellow American,If you’re a Patriot who knows that we MUST accelerate the pace of deportations, Or at least in the next 48 hours. My team at NumbersUSA has 29 years of experience and success in harnessing the power of grassroots armies of American Patriots to defeat the open-borders activists.And we are launching a nationwide petition drive built around 3 simple steps to reach 1 million deportations by year end: 1. Ban all local and federal rewards for illegal aliens 2. Shut off income for illegal aliens through “E-Verify” 3. Unleash ICE to the full extent of the law President Trump has closed the Southern Border, but we still have most of the 8 million Biden Border Crashers (and at least 15-17 MILLION illegal aliens total)......costing taxpayers an estimated $150 BILLION dollars a year.Our hospitals are overcrowded, our public services are overextended, and millions of Americans have been replaced by illegal workers. We literally cannot afford to delay. The Radical Left seems fixated on creating societal upheaval by overwhelming our borders and immigration system. That’s why they’re using the courts to stall and stop all deportations –- because it would take at least 15 YEARS to provide each illegal alien in our country all the extra reviews and appeals the open-borders radicals are demanding. They want to make this invasion permanent, and they are sabotaging the deportation operation at every turn......but our BAN, SHUTOFF & UNLEASH steps will trigger a wave of deportations and self-deportations that the Radical Left will be powerless to stop, and it’ll snowball from there.We start with 1 million and then keep on going. Patriots in the Trump Administration like JD Vance, Stephen Miller, and Tom Homan are going to battle every day to:Carry out the requirements for deportations that are contained in laws passed by previous Congresses ... Battle state and local governments that violate federal laws by shielding illegal aliens and the outlaw businesses that hire them....And Resist pressure from corporate media and lobbies to protect the illegal workforce.In other words, these patriots are fighting to deliver on their promises. , my name is Roy Beck, and I’m the founder of NumbersUSA—the largest single-issue grassroots advocacy group in the nation.NumbersUSA brings together a grassroots network of millions for one purpose: America First, lower-immigration policy.We have the experience, the scale, and most importantly, we have a plan to make sure the Trump administration hits its deportation goals.But I need your help to execute these three simple steps for deporting at least 1 million in Year One. Let me explain those 3 steps in a little more detail: 1\. Ban all local and federal rewards for illegal aliens. Until we cut off all the taxpayer subsidies to illegal aliens of housing, health care, and tuition... ...and stop granting them driver’s licenses, Social Security numbers, and other privileges of a U.S. citizen, illegals have no reason to leave. 2\. Shut off income for illegal aliens through nationwide “E-Verify.” Most illegal aliens will eventually go home if they can’t obtain U.S. jobs. “E-Verify” has long been available through the Department of Homeland Security. It allows employers to ensure they are hiring Americans and not illegal workers. But nobody is required to use it, so the anti-American employers don’t. Mandating E-Verify for all employers is an obvious first step Congress must take to make sure sanctuary governors and mayors aren’t helping illegals to take jobs from American workers and undercut their wages. 3\. Unleash ICE to the full extent of the law. We’re already seeing many illegal aliens choose to leave on their own terms instead of in handcuffs with an ICE agent...But we need more of this.Sanctuary Cities, uncooperative local officials, and anti-ICE activists keep impeding ICE’s critical work. To overcome their resistance, we’ll need more funding and more public pressure.......and more laws passed by Congress so a future President can’t open the floodgates ever again. We’ve already seen the entire radical Leftist apparatus mobilize nationwide, foreign-flag-waving street demonstrations in favor of illegal immigration.The fiery images of the demonstrations show how passionate they are for the right of all foreign tourists, guest workers, and illegal aliens to stay and work in our country forever. So, you know they will never consent to 1 million deportations. And they’ll definitely never consent to the largest deportation operation in history! there is no better group to organize it than NumbersUSA. Putting pressure on Congress is what we at NumbersUSA have been doing for a quarter-century.Back in 1996, we pioneered the tactic of masses of voters using the newly accessible internet to pressure elected officials directly. Then in 2007, when Ted Kennedy and sellout Republicans wanted to import millions more foreign workers and give amnesty to millions of illegal immigrants, NumbersUSA mobilized citizens in such numbers that they shut down the Congressional switchboard. The New York Times credited us (or maybe blamed us) for blocking that bill. All told, NumbersUSA has reduced possible immigration to the U.S. by over 40 MILLION through our many grassroots victories.We know how to give the American people a voice on Capitol Hill that no lawmaker or talking head can ignore.So if you’re frustrated by the well-funded and organized protests slowing down deportations... If you’re worried about all the illegals still here... And if you want to make a difference right now... Because you understand how urgent this is, I’m asking you to consider making a gift of $27, $50, $100 or even as much as $500 or $1,000 when you submit your petition today.With a donation of $27, you can become a member of NumbersUSA and join the millions of Americans across our great land demanding an America First lower-immigration policy. If you can’t afford $27 today, consider just $3.97—the approximate cost of processing your petition.But of course, larger gifts will accelerate our petition drive’s nationwide roll-out and intensify the pressure on Capitol Hill. To kick the deportations into overdrive, we need to light a fire under every open-borders politician and bureaucrat who’s holding things up. Thank you for reading my email today. It’s Patriots like you who give me hope for our country’s future. | | Roy Beck FounderNumbersUSA | | | P.S. Click the button below to access your Deport 1 Million Petition. Meet Royce White:

**Born and raised in the Twin Cities, Royce White was the son of a single mother and started playing sports at the age of 5 years old. Living in various neighborhoods growing up, much of his family remained in the Rondo community, where he spent much of his time and received schooling. White excelled at basketball and recieved a scholarship to play basketball at the University of Minnesota, and later transferred to Iowa State. He would go on to make Dean's List while receiving All Big-12 first-team honors and many other basketball awards.

_After being selected 16th overall by The Houston Rockets in the NBA draft, White began to voice concerns about the NBA’s collective bargaining agreement (CBA), specifically regarding mental health policy, which at the time did not exist. Eventually, his concerns became a public dispute between White and the NBA. This resulted in White demanding that the NBA, as a representative of the global corporate community, take up the responsibility of spearheading the mental health conversation – not just posturing through press statements, but through policy._

Royce then went on to win two championships in Canada before moving over to play Big 3 Basketball. White appeared at a game in a t-shirt that read “Free The Uyghurs.” After a game-winning basket, White did a post-game interview on CBS, where he called for 2 Million Uyghurs to be freed and released from concentration camps. As the season went on, White would touch on taboo topics such as Gain of Function Research, The Federal Reserve, Julian Assange, Edward Snowden, Larry Hoover, Jeff Fort, Muammar Gaddafi, The Great Reset, Ivermectin, Me Too, etc._

Now, Royce White is running for Senate in Minnesota to take down the Radical Left. Republicans have not seen recent success in Minnesota, but Royce's campaign is different: a grassroots movement that's sick of the Radical Agenda pushed by Far Left Democrats Tina Smith and Ilhan Omar. Royce needs your help to pull off a fourth quarter comeback victory and FLIP Minnesota Red for Republicans.

The governor’s office in New Mexico has flipped parties every 8 years since the 1990s.
# [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/133?t=1&akid=2856%2E400544%2EYUX-GT)
**[Is there anything we can say to encourage you to make a donation before Deb’s end-of-quarter fundraising deadline on Monday?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250626_2_eoq?amount=5&refcode=em20250626-2856&refcode2=2856_400544_YUX-GT&akid=2856%2E400544%2EYUX-GT)**
What if we told you that this race here in New Mexico is one of the **most competitive** in the country?
And what if we said that we’re hearing rumors that a Republican who could drop **millions of his own funds** into the race overnight is eyeing the seat?

Here’s what I’ve been up to: • **Standing with immigrant communities:** Earlier this month, I visited the Northwest Detention Center – unannounced – with my colleagues Reps. Jayapal and Dexter. What I saw there, and in the ICE raids in communities here in Washington and nationwide, is the Trump administration targeting our neighbors, coworkers, parents, and siblings with no regard for due process. I’m calling out Trump’s anti-immigrant rhetoric and manufactured crisis what it is – a transparently authoritarian power grab – and I won’t step down. • **Upholding our promise to safeguard Tribal sovereignty amidst the ongoing climate crisis:** As Washington enters another dangerous wildfire season, I helped reintroduce legislation to remove red tape for Tribal Nations to attain the necessary federal resources to manage and respond to the devastation of natural disasters. The climate crisis isn’t slowing down, so neither can we – and I’m committed to ensuring all of our communities are prepared. • **I voted NO against the GOP’s Big Ugly Bill:** After marathon committee markups, House Republicans passed their disastrous spending package in the cover of night. This budget proposal slashes funding for essential programs like Medicaid and SNAP, all to pay for massive tax breaks benefitting corporations and the ultra-wealthy. Senate Democrats are now fighting to keep this reckless plan from being implemented, and rest assured that I will continue to stand up for our communities no matter the outcome. • **Committed to the transportation infrastructure we need:** I joined my colleagues Reps. Begich (AK), Garamendi (CA), and Malliotakis (NY) to launch the bipartisan Congressional Ferry Caucus. Our communities rely on ferries for daily commutes, accessing medical care, and connecting with friends and family. Together, we’re advocating for long-term federal investment in public ferry systems, because these boats are more than just transportation, they’re a lifeline for so many. • **Protecting our treasured wilderness:** Washington State’s forests, rivers, and wilderness are vital to our communities, crown jewels that shape so much of our lives. I joined with Sen. Patty Murray to introduce legislation that would permanently protect more than 100k acres of Olympic National Forestland and 464 river miles. Protecting our precious natural resources also means protecting local economies, livelihoods, and Tribal Sovereignty – and as Senate Republicans push ahead with their plan to sell off more than 250 million acres of public lands, this is a fight which we cannot and will not concede. • **Preparing for Pride celebrations:** I’m so excited to serve as the grand marshal of the Seattle Pride Parade this Sunday! This means so much to me, particularly this year. So many politicians from state legislatures to Congress are stoking fear and hatred against the LGBTQ+ community. We have to show support for queer kids and families, elders and community service organizations in every way we can — whether that’s speaking on the House floor or expressing **joy and pride** in our streets. I was honored to sit down with Bree Coven from the _Seattle Times_ a few weeks back to talk about what Pride means to me, _[**take a look here.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/110322639/553974445/1932879312?refcode=RS_EM_EN_2025.06.26_JuneNewsletter_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MTkxZjRkMy1lMTUyLWYwMTEtOGY3Yy02MDQ1YmRmZThlOWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6LV9nRXBxW491RE2e2yHWoLec2MlE9X0ddLJG6jdcyA=&emci=cbdd40c3-d252-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&emdi=9191f4d3-e152-f011-8f7c-6045bdfe8e9c&ceid=23483442)_ Now, I have an ask for you.
